scripts.text:
[Errende]
Why, hello there~
Isn't the weather
especially pleasant today?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哎呀，你好呀~今天的天氣格外宜人呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah~ There are only two things that can make this picturesque moment even more beautiful: story and song. Now then, which would you like to hear?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊~要讓這如畫美景更添風采，只有故事和歌聲了。那麼，您想聽哪一個呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hmmm?
Is that the seal of black...? Huh. Kino Kitty removed the one he gave me without a trace, so I surmise that he likes you a lot. Otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯？
那是黑色的印記...？
哈。
基諾·基蒂把我給他的那個印記抹得乾乾淨淨，看來他很喜歡您。
不然的話...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give Errende the letter
you have received from Kino Kitty.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF您將收到的基諾·基蒂的信件交給了艾倫德。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Er, he knows everything already? From this spot of blood, I think he still has health problems. He should stop torturing himself...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
呃，他已經知道一切了？從這灘血跡看來，他的身體似乎還是有問題。他該停止折磨自己了...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Thank you, I really appreciate what you've done for me. But, what would be an appropriate way to express my gratitude for an adventurer like yourself?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
謝謝您，我非常感激您為我所做的一切。但是，對於像您這樣的冒險者，什麼樣的方式才能表達我的謝意呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, so how did it go?
Wait, you already found it?
Yes, this is it! Great!
This is so amazing!!
Ah, yes, right.
Right.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊，那麼，結果如何？
等等，您已經找到了？
是的，就是這個！
太棒了！
這真是太神奇了！！
啊，是的，沒錯。
沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I would like to express my gratitute. But, what would be appropriate for an adventurer
like yourself?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我想表達我的感激之情。
但是，對於像您這樣的冒險者，什麼樣的方式才合適呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh~! I have just the thing. Alright, please make yourself comfortable, and listen to my song.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哦~！我正好有個主意。好了，請坐舒服點，聽我唱首歌吧。

scripts.text:
^483D8BEvery god never grows old
Because of beautiful
Goddess, Idun.
Keeper of the apples of youth
Goddess of immortality.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B眾神永不衰老，
皆因美麗的女神伊登。
青春之果的守護者，
永生女神。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BEvery god never grows old.
Idun, the wife of Bragi,
Idun, Odin's daughter in law~
The apples she keeps
In her basket.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B眾神永不衰老。
伊登，布拉基的妻子，
伊登，奧丁的兒媳~
她守護著籃子裡的蘋果。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BWithout Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
Even Thor, the strongest of gods,
would grow frail, Megingjard would
slip from his waist, and Mjolnir
would never fly again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B沒有伊登，
眾神都將
屈服於衰老。
即使是眾神中最強的托爾，
也會變得虛弱，梅金吉奧德會
從他的腰間滑落，妙爾尼爾
也將再不能飛翔。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BWithout Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
Loki was careless once,
and made her lost to the gods.
He was forced to get her back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B沒有伊登，
眾神都將
屈服於衰老。
洛基曾一時疏忽，
讓她與眾神失散。
他被迫將她找回。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BMy goddess stands
In the field of Asgard
She hands me fruit from heaven.
You will be loved by every god...
You will be blessed
By every god...^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B我的女神佇立
在阿斯加德的田野上，
她遞給我天界的果實。
您將受到眾神的喜愛...
您將受到眾神的祝福...^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BIf you share the
Apple of youth with me
Even a bite of it with
This poor poet.
You will be loved by every god...
You will be blessed
By every god...^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B如果您願意與我分享
青春之果，
哪怕讓這位貧窮的詩人
也嘗上一口。
您將受到眾神的喜愛...
您將受到眾神的祝福...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFWhile listening to his song, you feel at ease, and your thoughts become clearer. You believe that you see the vision of an angel, and you gain some experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF聽著他的歌聲，您感到身心舒暢，思緒也變得清晰起來。您彷彿看到了天使的幻象，並獲得了一些經驗值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
So, how do you feel now? I hope my song has refreshed you. I'm afraid it may not be enough to repay you, but please understand that this is the best way for me to express my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
那麼，您現在感覺如何？希望我的歌聲能讓您煥然一新。恐怕這不足以報答您的恩情，但請理解，這是我表達感激之情的最佳方式。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Besides, I've been thinking of you now as my friend, with whom I may candidly speak without any worry. And I think you have a beautiful smile. Am I wrong~? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
此外，我已將您視為朋友，可以毫無顧慮地與您坦誠相待。而且，我覺得您的笑容很美。我說錯了嗎~？哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I hope that you'll always remain honest and respectful towards other people, and that you continue to ignore greed for fortune or power.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
希望您永遠真誠待人、尊重他人，不要被對財富和權力的貪慾所左右。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It seems you haven't found it yet. Well, take your time, I can wait as long as you want. It doesn't really bore me, since waiting seems to be a part of my profession.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
看來您還沒找到呢。好吧，慢慢來，我可以等您多久都行。這並不會讓我感到無聊，因為等待似乎是我職業的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Mr. Skezti has a small book store on the book street at the right side of Mineta in Juno. If you show him the seal, he'll help you out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
斯凱齊先生在朱諾米內塔右側的書街上開了一家小書店。如果您向他出示封印，他會幫您的忙。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
So, have you met Mr. Kitty?
Ah, in Morocc? He has a chronic disease, but obviously doesn't
seem to care about it.
So what did he say?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
那麼，您見過基諾·基蒂先生了嗎？
啊，在夢羅克？
他患有慢性病，但顯然毫不在意。
那他說了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hm? In Juno?
Then that must be it.
It won't be easy if you want to go visit Mr. Sketzi's book store. Here, let me mark you with
^483D8BThe Seal of Friendship^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯？
在朱諾？
那應該就是那裡了。
如果您想去拜訪斯凱齊先生的書店，恐怕不會太容易。
來，讓我為您蓋上^483D8B友誼之印^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Give me your left hand.
Now, let me cast a spell...
*Mumble mumble...*
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
請伸出您的左手。
好，讓我施展一個法術...*嘟囔嘟囔...*

scripts.text: ^3355FFOn your left wrist, a crescent shaped mark glowing with a silver light appeared. It's only noticeable when you concentrate on finding it, but it might clearly appear under the moonlight.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF您的左手腕上出現了一個新月形的印記，散發著銀色的光芒。只有在刻意尋找時才會注意到它，但在月光下，它會清晰可見。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
There you go. Now, you may go to Mr. Sketzi. Remember, you must
show him the Seal of Friendship.
Good luck, now~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
好了。
現在，您可以去找斯凱齊先生了。
記住，您必須向他出示友誼之印。
祝您好運~

scripts.text:
[Bard]
^483D8BWhat day is
best for drinking?
La la la~
It's the day of
the earth, the sun
And the moon~
La la la~^000000
scripts.translation:
[詩人]
^483D8B哪一天最適合喝酒？
La la la~
那是大地、太陽
和月亮的日子~
La la la~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLa la la~
I'll only
drink on one day~
So if you'll tell me
when you'll drink
I'll tell you when
I'll drink with you~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8BLa la la~
我只在一天喝酒~
所以如果你告訴我
你什麼時候喝酒，
我就告訴你什麼時候
陪你一起喝~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLet's get together
Yea yea ye-^000000 Hmmmmm...?
scripts.translation: ^483D8B讓我們聚在一起耶耶耶-^000000 嗯嗯嗯...？

scripts.text:
[Bard]
Why, hello there. Oh, have you come to listen to my song and forget your worries?
scripts.translation:
[詩人]
哎呀，您好。哦，您是來聽我唱歌、忘掉煩惱的嗎？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem to be
new around here...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起來是新來的...你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Mm? Ah yes. I am merely another wandering poet who goes where the wind takes him. Please call me ^483D8BErrende^000000, the Bard who wishes to please you.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯？啊，是的。我只是一個隨風流浪的詩人，風把我吹到哪裡，我就去哪裡。請叫我^483D8B艾倫德^000000，一位希望取悅您的詩人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
If you will let me, I will tell you of my travels. By your leave,
I will play a song that will help you forget your troubles.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
如果您允許，我想跟您講講我的旅途見聞。請容我為您彈奏一首歌，幫您忘卻煩惱。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Waaah, wah~
You can't just ignore me like that! Where's your sense of merriment, your sense of romance?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哇, 哇~您不能就這樣無視我！您的歡樂感呢，您的浪漫感呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
How could I forget the song?
I'm worthless as a Bard~!
Please... Just...
Please just leave
me alone.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我怎麼可能忘記那首歌？
我作為一個詩人太沒用了~！
請...只是...請讓我一個人待著。

scripts.text: No problem~
scripts.translation: 沒問題~

scripts.text: Is there any way I can help you?
scripts.translation: 有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Waaaah~! You're so mean!
You're supposed to say, 'Errende, what's wrong? Maybe I can help?'
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哇~!
您太壞了！
您應該說：“艾倫德，你怎麼了？也許我能幫上忙？”

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I mean, we're supposed
to know each other better
than that. But...
Maybe I was wrong!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我的意思是，我們應該比這更瞭解彼此。
但是...也許我錯了！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
*Sob...*
Who made this poor Bard cry by neglecting him? *Sniff* I do believe it was you!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
*嗚嗚...*是誰讓這位可憐的詩人因為被忽視而哭泣？
*吸吸鼻子* 我相信是您！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Help me?
Hmmm...
That's it!
Gunther!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
幫我？
嗯...對了！
岡瑟！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Let me ask you a favor.
If perchance you happen to meet ^483D8BGunther Doubleharmony^000000, please inform him of my dilemna.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
請幫我一個忙。
如果您碰巧遇到^483D8B岡瑟·雙和諧^000000，請告訴他我的困境。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Tell him that ^483D8BMinty Errende^000000 happened to forget a line of the song, ^483D8BAt One, I Fall in Love^000000. The line is called ^483D8B8th love^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
告訴他，^483D8B薄荷·艾倫德^000000不小心忘記了歌曲^483D8B《一見鍾情》^000000中的一句歌詞。那句歌詞叫^483D8B“第八種愛”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I beseech you, if you meet him, please ask him of the 8th love and inform me of that lyric immediately~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
拜託了，如果見到他，請向他詢問“第八種愛”的歌詞，並立刻告訴我~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Argh...!
Who changed the words of this song anyway? It's really difficult to understand. I wish I could ask the person who changed the words.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊...！
到底是誰改了這首歌的歌詞？
真的很難理解。
我真想問問那個改歌詞的人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
This is so frustrating!
Now, I've lost the passion
to sing or play...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
太讓人沮喪了！
現在，我失去了唱歌或演奏的熱情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you think...
The person would be...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不覺得...那個人會是...嗎？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah! Of course!
I think you're right!
How could I not think of that?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊！
當然！
我覺得您說得對！
我怎麼沒想到呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It all makes sense now. After all, he used to be a member of the Invincible Single Army. His changes might have been a little mean, since this song used to be about a happy couple...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
現在一切都說得通了。畢竟，他曾經是“單身軍團”的成員。他的改動可能有些刻薄，因為這首歌原本講的是一對幸福情侶的故事...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ummm...
I'm sorry to ask a favor of you again, but in your travels, do you think you could find the original lyrics for this song? I can wait for it...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯...很抱歉又要麻煩您，但在您的旅途中，能否幫我找到這首歌的原始歌詞？我可以等...

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: I can, so stop crying.
scripts.translation: 我可以，別哭了

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, I guess it was too much to ask of you. My apologies. Don't worry about it, I'll find out some other way.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊，看來是我太強人所難了，抱歉。別放在心上，我另想辦法吧。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Are you serious?
Oh, thank you so much!
You must be an angel!
An angel that truly understands the heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您是認真的嗎？太感謝您了！您一定是天使！
一位真正理解詩人心靈的天使！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I'll pay you back somehow!
Thank you for your trouble
in advance~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我一定會報答您的！也先謝謝您的幫忙~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
岡瑟？我覺得他不會這麼做。他總是在歌里加入“為你帶來雙和諧”之類的歌詞。而且，他沒那麼傻，不會做這種事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
岡瑟？我覺得他不會這麼做。他總是在歌里加入“為你帶來雙和諧”之類的歌詞。而且，他沒那麼傻，不會做這種事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Surely you jest!
If I did, why would
I not know what
this song is about?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您肯定在開玩笑！
如果是我，我怎麼會不知道這首歌是關於什麼的呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
{0}...?
I don't think I know that person. Maybe you misunderstood
something? *Sigh...*
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
{0}...？
我不認識那個人。
也許您誤會了什麼？
*嘆氣...*

scripts.text:
[Errende]
What was the line...?
How could I forget
the 8th love?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
那句歌詞是...？
我怎麼會忘記“第八種愛”呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh...!
These tears just won't stop!
Wh-why must people always treat Bards like this?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哦...！
這些眼淚根本停不下來！
為...為什麼人們總是這樣對待詩人？

scripts.text:
^483D8BWho made
this poor Bard cry?
Who broke his
tender heart of glass?
Shattering his dreams...^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B是誰讓這位可憐的詩人哭泣？
是誰打碎了他玻璃般脆弱的心？
粉碎了他的夢想...^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BNo dreams,
No heart,
No love,
No hope
No....^000000
scripts.translation: ^483D8B沒有夢想，沒有心，沒有愛，沒有希望，沒有...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFErrende continues to sing about his personal despair. He seems to be disappointed in your refusal to help him. Of course, you begin to feel sorry for him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾倫德繼續唱著關於他個人絕望的歌。他似乎對你拒絕幫助他感到失望。當然，你開始為他感到難過。^000000

scripts.text: Well, I should help him then...
scripts.translation: 好吧，我還是幫幫他吧

scripts.text: Ignore him anyway.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey. Hey, Errende. Stop singing this song. It's embarassing, okay? Alright, I'll go find the original song for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，艾倫德，別唱這首歌了。太丟人了，好嗎？好吧，我這就去幫你找回原曲。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
*Gasp!* Really! Are you sure? Thank you! Thank you so much!
You really do care about
the sadness of a Bard!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
*倒吸一口氣!* 真的嗎！您確定嗎？謝謝！太感謝了！
您真的在乎詩人的悲傷！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I promise to pay you back as best as I can! I'll wait for you here until you return!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我保證會盡力報答您！我會在這裡等您回來！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ignore his
heart wrenching song.
But at what cost to your soul?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你無視了他令人心碎的歌曲。
但這對你的靈魂造成了什麼代價？^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You don't have anything you want to ask me, do you? If not, would you like to listen to my song...?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您沒有什麼想問我的吧？如果沒有，您想聽聽我的歌嗎...？

scripts.text:
^483D8BMiiiiserable...
Noboooody looooves meee
Friends foooooor never...
Ooooooooh wah!^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B悲慘...
沒有人愛我
朋友永遠離我而去...
Ooooooooh 哇!^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Umm...
I am not sure exactly where Mr. Kitty is. Maybe you might be able to find out at the Monster Museum in Juno? I think he's a member of the Monster Research Organization.
scripts.translation:

您見過岡瑟嗎？
啊，也許您還沒見過他。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
*Sigh* I've lost the heart to sing ever since I forgotten that line to the song. I just... can't. My spirit is unmoved. There's no inspiration.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
*嘆氣* 自從忘記了那句歌詞，我就失去了唱歌的心。我只是...做不到。我的精神無法被觸動。沒有靈感。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Please ask ^483D8BGunther^000000 about the ^483D8B8th love^000000 in ^483D8BAt One, I Fall in Love^000000. Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
請向^483D8B岡瑟^000000詢問《一見鍾情》中^483D8B第八種愛^000000，在^483D8B《一見鍾情》^000000中的歌詞。先謝謝您了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
So...
Have you
seen Gunther?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
那個...您見過岡瑟嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou turn around
to show him your back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你轉過身，把後背展示給他看。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Huh...?!
Isn't that?!
Is that the line of the song written on your back? Wait, don't move! The 8th love is...
Now I see!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
咦...？！
那不是...？！
那是寫在您背上的歌詞嗎？
等等，別動！第八種愛是...我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At One, I fall in love.
At Two, you give me your smile.
At Three, I adore your touch.
At Four, a tender kiss.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
一見，我墜入愛河。
二見，你對我微笑。
三見，我迷戀你的觸碰。
四見，溫柔的親吻。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At Five, we change our minds.
A petal scatters through the air.
At Six, I fall in love~
At Seven, you fall in love~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
五見，我們改變了心意。
花瓣在空中飄散。
六見，我墜入愛河~
七見，你墜入愛河~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At Eight we turn away...
At Nine, love is reborn.
At Ten, my Love is gone.
At Eleven I find out why.
At Twelve I see her new boyfriend?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
八見，我們轉身離去...
九見，愛重獲新生。
十見，我的愛消失了。
十一見，我得知了原因。
十二見，我看到了她的新男友？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At Eight we turn away...
At Nine, love is reborn.
At Ten, my Love is gone.
At Eleven I find out why.
At Twelve I see his new girlfriend?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
八見，我們轉身離去...
九見，愛重獲新生。
十見，我的愛消失了。
十一見，我得知了原因。
十二見，我看到了他的新女朋友？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
...

[Errende]
This...
This cannot be.
This song is supposed to be about love, not a romantic travesty!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
這...這不可能。
這首歌應該是關於愛的，而不是這種荒謬的鬧劇！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
The lyrics. They must have been changed. Did Gunther say anything about this?! Hmmm, but who would change the lyrics...?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
歌詞。肯定是被改過了。岡瑟有沒有說過什麼？可是，到底是誰會去改歌詞呢...？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah! Of course!
I think you're right!
How could I not think of that?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊！
當然！
我覺得您說得對！
我怎麼沒想到呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It all makes sense now. After all, he used to be a member of the Invincible Single Army. His changes might have been a little mean, since this song used to be about a happy couple...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
現在一切都說得通了。畢竟，他曾經是“單身軍團”的成員。他的改動可能有些刻薄，因為這首歌原本講的是一對幸福情侶的故事...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ummm...
I'm sorry to ask a favor of you again, but in your travels, do you think you could find the original lyrics for this song? I can wait for it...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯...很抱歉又要麻煩您，但在您的旅途中，能否幫我找到這首歌的原始歌詞？我可以等...

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: I can, so stop crying.
scripts.translation: 我可以，別哭了

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, I guess it was too much to ask of you. My apologies. Don't worry about it, I'll find out some other way.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊，看來是我太強人所難了，抱歉。別放在心上，我另想辦法吧。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Are you serious? Oh, thank you so much! You must be an angel! An angel that truly understands the heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您是認真的嗎？太感謝您了！您一定是天使！
一位真正理解詩人心靈的天使！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I'll pay you back somehow! Thank you for your trouble in advance~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我一定會報答您的！也先謝謝您的幫忙~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
岡瑟？我覺得他不會這麼做。他總是在歌里加入“為你帶來雙和諧”之類的歌詞。而且，他沒那麼傻，不會做這種事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Gunther? I don't think he would do this. He always puts lines in his songs like 'doubleharmony for you.' Plus, he's too silly for that.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
岡瑟？我覺得他不會這麼做。他總是在歌里加入“為你帶來雙和諧”之類的歌詞。而且，他沒那麼傻，不會做這種事。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Surely you jest! If I did, why would I not know what this song is about?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您肯定在開玩笑吧！如果是我改的，我怎麼會不知道這首歌是關於什麼的呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
{0}...?
I don't think I know that person. Maybe you misunderstood something? *Sigh...*
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
{0}...？
我不認識那個人。
也許您誤會了什麼？
*嘆氣...*

scripts.text:
[Errende]
What was the line...?
How could I forget
the 8th love?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
那句歌詞是...？
我怎麼會忘記“第八種愛”呢？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Welcome back,
{0}~
What would you like
me to do for you?
Would you like to hear
a tale or listen to a song?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
歡迎回來，{0}~
您想讓我為您做些什麼？
您想聽故事，還是聽歌？

scripts.text:
^483D8BWhat day is
best for drinking?
La la la~
It's the day of
the earth, the sun
And the moon~
La la la~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B哪一天最適合喝酒？
La la la~
那是大地、太陽
和月亮的日子~
La la la~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLa la la~
I'll only
drink on one day~
So if you'll tell me
when you'll drink
I'll tell you when
I'll drink with you~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8BLa la la~
我只在一天喝酒~
所以如果你告訴我
你什麼時候喝酒，
我就告訴你什麼時候
陪你一起喝~^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BLet's get together
Yea yea ye-^000000 Hmmmmm...?
scripts.translation: ^483D8B讓我們聚在一起Yea yea ye-^000000 嗯嗯嗯...？

scripts.text:
[Bard]
Why, hello there. Oh, have you come to listen to my song and forget your worries?
scripts.translation:
[詩人]
哎呀，您好。哦，您是來聽我唱歌、忘掉煩惱的嗎？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem to be
new around here...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起來是新來的...你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Mm? Ah yes. I am merely another wandering poet who goes where the wind takes him. Please call me ^483D8BErrende^000000, the Bard who wishes to please you.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯？啊，是的。我只是一個隨風流浪的詩人，風把我吹到哪裡我就去哪裡。請叫我^483D8B艾倫德^000000，一位希望取悅您的詩人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
If you will let me, I will tell you of my travels. By your leave,
I will play a song that will help you forget your troubles.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
如果您允許，我想告訴您我的旅途見聞。請容我為您彈奏一首歌，幫您忘卻煩惱。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Waaah, wah~
You can't just ignore me like that! Where's your sense of merriment, your sense of romance?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哇, 哇~您不能就這樣無視我！您的歡樂感呢，您的浪漫感呢？

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 給我講個故事

scripts.text: Would you play a song?
scripts.translation: 你會演奏歌曲嗎？

scripts.text: Eh, maybe later.
scripts.translation: 嗯，也許以後再說

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You like stories, huh? What kind of story would you like me to tell? I'll you whatever I know... Just for you, of course. *Grins*
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您喜歡聽故事，是嗎？您想聽什麼樣的故事？我會把我知道的都講給您聽...當然，只為您一人。*Grins*

scripts.text: News and rumors~
scripts.translation: 新聞和傳聞~

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hmmm. Then shall we talk about this town, Geffen? Have you ever been to the Pub or the Inn here?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯。那我們來聊聊這座城鎮吉芬吧？您以前來過這裡的酒館或旅店嗎？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Okay, let me tell you a story about Morocc, city of the desert. Adventurers worth their salt are expected to have explored the city and its surrounding desert.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
好吧，讓我給您講一個關於沙漠之城夢羅克的故事。值得稱道的冒險者都應該探索過這座城市及其周圍的沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Why don't we talk about Alberta? There is a sunken ship developed by an event agency as a place where adventurers may go on expeditions. It seems they're making a lot of money.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我們為什麼不聊聊艾爾貝塔呢？那裡有一艘由活動機構改造的沉船，供冒險者探險之用。看來他們賺了不少錢呢。

scripts.text: [Errende]
scripts.translation: [艾倫德]

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I'd be lying if I didn't say that the sisters that work the Pub and Inn are... ^FF6699sensuously captivating^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
如果我說，在酒館和旅店工作的那對姐妹花... ^FF6699風情萬種^000000，那絕對不算撒謊。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
The elder one is gorgeous, graceful and carries with her an air of refinement. And the younger one is so cheerful, energetic and so... ^FF6699nubile^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
姐姐美麗優雅，氣質高貴。而妹妹則活潑開朗，充滿朝氣，真是... ^FF6699正值青春^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
But I digress.
Sometimes though,
just sometimes mind you,
they're not as sexy as usual.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
不過，我跑題了。
只是偶爾，請相信我，她們會沒有平時那麼迷人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It seems the spirit of their late father, God bless his soul for siring such hot women, possesses them from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
看來她們已故的父親——願上帝保佑他生出這麼迷人的女兒——的靈魂，時不時會附在她們身上。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I guess when someone acts even
a little flirtacious towards those girls, their father's spirit takes over. I should know.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我想，只要有人對那兩位姑娘稍有調情的意思，她們父親的靈魂就會接管她們的身體。
我可是深有體會。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I guess a father's love endures forever, even into the afterlife. Of course, I wouldn't know.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我想，父愛是永恆的，甚至能延續到來世。當然，這只是我的猜測。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Let's see...
Look out for this really shady Merchant that hangs out behind
the Pub in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
讓我想想...留意一下那個在吉芬酒館後面出沒的可疑商人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Judging from his clothes, he must be from Morocc, which is a lot warmer. That's why he's got a Hood, even though it has no drawstrings, for the cooler weather over here.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
從他的穿著來看，他應該來自氣候更溫暖的夢羅克。所以即使天氣較涼，他也戴著一頂沒有抽繩的兜帽。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I must warn you, don't let him talk you into buying that Hood of his since he's selling it for an outrageous price. He's definitely not trustworthy.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我必須提醒您，別被他說動去買那頂兜帽，他的開價高得離譜。他絕對不可信。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Lastly, I want to mention the lost city of Geffenia, hidden under the Geffen Tower. I hear some kind of condition is required to enter Geffenia, but I'm not sure.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
最後，我想提一下隱藏在吉芬塔下的失落之城——吉芬尼亞。聽說進入吉芬尼亞需要滿足某種條件，但我不太確定。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Geffenia is related to the two attractive ladies I mentioned earlier. It seems their father, William, entered Geffen Tower with a party to exterminate monsters, but he never returned.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
吉芬尼亞與我之前提到的那兩位迷人的女士有關。據說她們的父親威廉曾帶領一支隊伍進入吉芬塔討伐魔物，但他再也沒有回來。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
It's tragic that he left his family behind in that way. But perhaps, it is more tragic that his spirit scares away anyone interested in those girls.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
他就這樣拋下家人，實在令人悲痛。但或許更悲劇的是，他的靈魂嚇跑了所有對那兩位姑娘感興趣的人。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
The Sphinx and the Pyramids are especially popular areas of exploration for adventurers. Have you been there before? I haven't yet, but perhaps someday I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
斯芬克斯和金字塔是冒險者特別熱衷的探索區域。您以前去過那裡嗎？我還沒去過，但也許有一天會去。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
While I was in Morocc, I found a Merchant that sells Sword Maces to Priests and Priestess. Aside from those, Priests are prohibited from using any kind of weapon with blades.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我在夢羅克時，發現了一位向牧師和女祭司出售尖刃鐵錘的商人。除了尖刃鐵錘，牧師被禁止使用任何帶刃的武器。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I also saw an energetic little boy who kept begging his father to tame a Munak for him. I heard the father speak a bit, and it seems that one of his friends from Morocc is lost in Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我還看到一個精力充沛的小男孩，一直纏著父親，要他幫忙馴服一隻妖道。我聽到父親說了幾句，似乎是他的一位朋友從夢羅克來，在艾爾貝塔迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
In any case, I helped the father with an errand, and he gave me a mysterious box in return. When I opened that box, I found a strange feather. I'm unaware of how it works, though...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
總之，我幫那位父親辦了件差事，他回贈我一個神秘的盒子。開啟盒子後，我發現了一根奇怪的羽毛。不過我不太清楚它的用途...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I wonder if that man's friend, Pandger Mayer, ever found
his way back home...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
不知道那位男士的朋友潘傑·梅耶，是否找到了回家的路...

scripts.text:
[Errende]
When the sunken ship first drifted near Alberta, it was immediately found by one of the Alberta Security Knights.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
當沉船最初漂到艾爾貝塔附近時，立刻被艾爾貝塔的一名安全騎士發現了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
That Security Knight ventured inside and found an infant deep inside one of the rooms. Next to the baby was a music box.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
那名安全騎士進入船內，在一個房間的深處發現了一個嬰兒。嬰兒旁邊放著一個八音盒。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
This baby was the one and only survivor from the sunken ship. He was brought up in Alberta, although he was treated with contempt when he was a child. He's fine now, but I digress.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
這個嬰兒是沉船上唯一的倖存者。他在艾爾貝塔長大，雖然小時候曾遭受輕視。他現在過得很好，不過我跑題了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
As for the sunken ship, I'm unsure of whether or not it was a pirate ship. It is said that skeleton monsters wearing pirate costumes roam its remains.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
至於那艘沉船，我不確定它是否是一艘海盜船。據說有穿著海盜服裝的邪骸戰士在殘骸附近遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
One of Alberta's other mysteries is the elusive Turtle Island. It seems that one seafarer has found a dependable route to that place and is giving passage to adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
艾爾貝塔的另一個謎團是難以尋找的海龜島。似乎有一位航海者找到了一條通往那裡的可靠航線，並正在為冒險者提供渡海服務。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Still, it seems Turtle Island is not quite safe. Two squads of Alberta Security Knights have already traveled there, but have not yet returned. Verily, this is cause for concern.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
不過，海龜島似乎並不完全安全。已經有兩支艾爾貝塔安全騎士小隊前往那裡，至今尚未返回。確實令人擔憂。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Still, that didn't stop me from visiting that place. By sheer accident, I found the journal of an adventurer who had already been there. It seems he's a famous scholar now.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
即便如此，我還是去了一趟。純屬偶然，我找到了一位去過那裡的冒險者的日記。看來他現在是位著名的學者了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
In that journal are details about an ultimate swordsman, and the exploration of Turtle Island. I'm sure that anyone seeking treasure in that place will find exciting adventure.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
日記中詳細記錄了一位終極劍士的事蹟，以及海龜島的探索過程。我相信，任何去那裡尋寶的人都會經歷一場激動人心的冒險。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh, how disappointing. But promise me that you will drop by later, so that we can share stories and merriment.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哎呀，真遺憾。不過請答應我，稍後再來，這樣我們就能一起分享故事和歡樂了。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You recognize my talent, so you deserve to listen to my songs! Now, what would you like to hear? I can play anything you want, you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您認可了我的才華，所以您也有資格聽我唱歌！那麼，您想聽什麼？您知道的，我可以演奏您想聽的任何曲子。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At last, I've met someone who recognizes my talent! You deserve to listen to my songs! Now, what would you like to hear? I can play anything you want, you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
終於，我遇到了一位認可我才華的人！您有資格聽我唱歌！那麼，您想聽什麼？您知道的，我可以演奏您想聽的任何曲子。

scripts.text: Hmm, any song will do.
scripts.translation: 隨便唱一首吧

scripts.text: Play an upbeat song~!
scripts.translation: 來首歡快的曲子~！

scripts.text: Never mind...
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Alright.
Here we go~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
好的。
這就開始~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ahahaha~
My apologies,
But I cannot offer my services for free. Even a Bard needs zeny to live, wouldn't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
Ahahaha~抱歉，但我不能免費提供服務。即使是詩人，也需要Zeny才能生活，您說對吧？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
An upbeat song...?
Hmmm... Let's see.
An upbeat song,
An upbeat song...
Okay, here we go~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
歡快的曲子...？
嗯...讓我想想。
歡快的曲子，歡快的曲子...好，開始咯~

scripts.text:
^483D8BValhalla dazzles in gold
The fifth as we know
Is old Glast Heim!
Glorious warriors answer
The summons of Odin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B瓦爾哈拉閃耀著金光，
我們所知的第五座，
是古老的葛拉斯特海姆！
光榮的戰士們回應奧丁的召喚。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BPalace of the dead
With a silver roof~
The third as we know...
Valaskjalf!
Glorious warriors answer
The summons of Odin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B亡者之宮頂著銀色的屋頂~
我們所知的第三座...
瓦拉斯克亞爾夫！
光榮的戰士們回應奧丁的召喚。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BFive hundred forty doors
In the grand halls of Valhalla
Fling open to the heart of a hero.
Eight hundred warriors gather
Under the will of God, and
Charge as one out through
Those doors.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B五百四十扇門，
在瓦爾哈拉宏偉的大殿中，
為英雄的心靈敞開。
八百名戰士聚集，
在神的意志之下，
一同衝出那些大門。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BGodly warriors
Step into Yggdrassil
Towards their fate.
With pride and honor,
They accept Valyrie's
Welcome.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B神勇的戰士們踏入世界樹，
走向他們的命運。
懷著驕傲與榮譽，
他們接受了瓦利耶的歡迎。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BWarriors fallen in battle
In glorious clashes of red
Death may have come,
But your fame lives on
and your spirit will be
led to Valhalla.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B戰死沙場的勇士，
在紅色的光榮交鋒中，
死亡或許已經降臨，
但你的名聲永存，
你的靈魂將被引向瓦爾哈拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
...

[Errende]
You know this song is about a legend regarding Valhalla don't you? Supposedly, more than one place was used as the sacred Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您知道這首歌講的是瓦爾哈拉的傳說吧？據說，不止一處地方曾被用作神聖的榮譽大廳。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
But only the gods will know if this was true or not. Was a place like Glast Heim really the fifth Valhalla? We humans
may never know
with certainty.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
但這是否屬實，恐怕只有神明知道。葛拉斯特海姆真的是第五座瓦爾哈拉嗎？我們人類或許永遠無法確定。

scripts.text:
^483D8BThe sounds of galloping
Echo in the distance.
A cloud of hazy dust
Fills the setting sun.
Thousands of eyes open
Torches on the castle
Flare like thousands of Ifrits.
scripts.translation:
^483D8B馬蹄聲
在遠處迴響。
朦朧的塵埃
籠罩著落日。
成千上萬雙眼睛睜開。
城堡上的火把
如同成千上萬的伊夫利特般燃燒。

scripts.text:
^483D8BHear the throbbing of my heart,
The blood flowing in my veins.
Feeling the heaviness of my armor.
The enemy has appeared before us.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B聽我心跳的搏動，
感受血液在我的血管中流淌。
感受盔甲的重量。
敵人已出現在我們面前。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BBeat the drums hard, harder!
Courage, soldiers, march forward!
Shout loud, soldiers, louder!
Today will never come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B用力敲鼓，更用力！
鼓起勇氣，士兵們，向前進！
大聲吶喊，士兵們，更響亮！
今天永遠不會再回來！^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BStun the sky
Provoke the earth.
I feel my heartbeat again.
Blow the bugle to
Sway the fortress.
Today will never come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B震撼天空，
挑釁大地。
我再次感到心跳加速。
吹響號角，
動搖堡壘。
今天永遠不會再回來！^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Ah, this is called 'Drumming in the Battlefield,' which was written by Mr. Iolo. Yes, I rather like this song.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
啊，這首曲子叫《戰場上的鼓聲》，是伊奧先生寫的。嗯，我挺喜歡這首歌的。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Heroic warrior,
Please listen to my song. If you have a flower in hand and are in love, let's count the flower petals as we go along.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
英勇的戰士，請聽我唱歌。
如果您手中拿著花，又正墜入愛河，就讓我們邊走邊數花瓣吧。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
My fair lady,
Please listen to my song. If you have a flower in hand and are in love, let's count the flower petals as we go along.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
美麗的女士，請聽我唱歌。
如果您手中拿著花，又正墜入愛河，就讓我們邊走邊數花瓣吧。

scripts.text:
^483D8BAt One, I fall in love.
At Two, you give me your smile.
At Three, I adore your touch.
At Four, a tender kiss.
At Five, we change our minds.
A petal scatters through the air.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B一見，我墜入愛河。
二見，你對我微笑。
三見，我迷戀你的觸碰。
四見，溫柔的親吻。
五見，我們改變了心意。
一片花瓣在空中飄落。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BAt Six, I fall in love~
At Seven, you fall in love~
At Eight~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B六見，我墜入愛河~
七見，你墜入愛河~
八見~^000000

scripts.text:
[Errende]
At eight~
At... Eight...
What was next...?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
八見~
八...見...接下來是什麼來著...？

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Oh my...!
What was the next part?!
What was the 8th love?!
How shameful for a Bard
to forget the words
to a song!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
哎呀...！
下一句是什麼來著？！
第八種愛是什麼？！
作為一個詩人，竟然忘了歌詞，真丟人！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I...
I can't bear the humiliation!
Or the suspense of what
happens next...!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
我...我無法忍受這種羞辱！
也無法忍受接下來會發生什麼的懸念...！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
You're an adventurer, aren't you? So you must travel quite a bit? It's embarassing for me to ask,
but I have a favor to ask...!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您是冒險者，對吧？那您一定經常四處旅行吧？雖然我有點難以啟齒，但有件事想請您幫忙...！

scripts.text: Sure, no problem.
scripts.translation: 沒問題，包在我身上

scripts.text: I ain't gonna help you.
scripts.translation: 我才不會幫你呢

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Thank you, so much!
Let's see, who would know?
I've got it! Gunther!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
太感謝了！
讓我想想，誰會知道呢？
我想到了！
岡瑟！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
If perchance you happen to meet ^483D8BGunther Doubleharmony^000000, please inform him of my dilemna.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
如果您碰巧遇到^483D8B岡瑟·雙和諧^000000，請告訴他我的困境。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Tell him that ^483D8BMinty Errende^000000 happened to forget a line of the song, ^483D8BAt One, I Fall in Love^000000. The line is called ^483D8B8th love^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
告訴他，^483D8B薄荷·艾倫德^000000不小心忘記了歌曲^483D8B《一見鍾情》^000000中的一句歌詞。那句歌詞叫^483D8B“第八種愛”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
I beseech you, if you meet him, please ask him of the 8th love and inform me of that lyric immediately~
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
拜託了，如果見到他，請向他詢問“第八種愛”的歌詞，並立刻告訴我~

scripts.text:
[Errende]
*Sigh...*
I can't remember the 8th part of this song if my life depended on it. And it does~! *Wahhhh~*
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
*嘆氣...*
就算我的性命攸關，我也想不起這首歌的第八部分了。
而且，我的性命確實懸著呢~！
*哇哇哇~*

scripts.text:
^483D8BA good Bard sings
To please his listener.
So do not expect a sad song
That deepens your anguish.^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B優秀的詩人歌唱是為了取悅聽眾。
所以請不要期待悲傷的歌曲，
來加深你的痛苦。^000000

scripts.text:
^483D8BA good Dancer dances
To please her audience.
Shall we dance together?
Just hold my hands.
La la la~ La la la~^000000
scripts.translation:
^483D8B優秀的舞娘起舞，是為了取悅觀眾。
我們要一起跳舞嗎？
請握住我的手。
La la la~ La la la~^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way...
Why do you guys play
discords sometimes?
It sounds weird
when you do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
順便問一下...
你們為什麼有時會演奏不和諧的音？
你們這樣做的時候，聽起來很怪異。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
H-how can you say such a thing, {0}? Have you ever been a Bard before? It's difficult to come up with fresh, original melodies!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
您...您怎麼能這麼說，{0}？您以前當過詩人嗎？創作新穎、原創的旋律可是很難的！

scripts.text:
[Errende]
But of course.
Merriment is best
enjoyed when you
are in the mood for it.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
當然可以。
快樂的心情，才最能享受歡樂。
請隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Errende]
Hmm~?
Well, alright. Though, listening to a good story or cheerful song can really do you some good. Alright then, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫德]
嗯~？
好吧。不過，聽一個好故事或歡快的歌曲，真的會讓人心情變好。那麼，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Everything will be
fine in the end, right?
I'll be okay, Jorti will be okay, and she'll be... Oh.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
一切最終都會好起來的，對吧？
我會沒事的，約爾蒂也會沒事的，她也會...哦。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm sorry, I was just
muttering to myself.
Is there anything
you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
抱歉，我剛才只是在自言自語。
你有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me a story...
scripts.translation: 給我講個故事

scripts.text: Your voice is...
scripts.translation: 你的聲音

scripts.text: No thanks, I appreciate it though.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝你的好意

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Many legends have been passed down as songs. Stories of Gods and tales of brave warriors have all been written as songs.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
許多傳說都被寫成了歌曲，流傳至今。眾神的故事與勇士的傳說，都化作了歌謠。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Many people love to listen to those songs because they dream of the romantic past. To sing these kinds of songs is the reason people like me exist.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
許多人喜歡這些歌，因為他們嚮往浪漫的往昔。而演唱這些歌，正是像我這樣的人存在的意義。

scripts.text: ^3355FFKino Kitty adjusted the strings on his guitar, and began to sing in a low voice.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基諾·基蒂調整了吉他的琴絃，開始用低沉的聲音歌唱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ARheingold...
Hidden in the Rhein river.
If made into a ring,
Could rule the world~^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A萊茵黃金...
隱藏在萊茵河中。
若製成指環，
可統治世界~^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AProtected by a spell
Cursing its thief
To never find love.
Alberich had known
Nonetheless stole it.
Love was forsaken for power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A受咒語守護，
詛咒著竊賊，
讓他永遠找不到愛情。
阿爾貝里希早已知曉，
卻仍然偷走了它。
為了權力，愛被拋棄了。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AGiants built beautiful Valhalla
Matrimony with Freya
Goddess of beauty
Their supposed payment.
In not receiving it
They forcefully took her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A巨人建造了美麗的瓦爾哈拉，
並以與美神芙蕾雅結為連理，
作為他們約定的報酬。
未能得到報酬，
他們便強行將她擄走了。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AThe gods would
give Alberich's treasure
To the Giants for Freya's return.
Loki tricked Alberich,
Stealing his ring or power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A眾神將阿爾貝里希的寶藏交給巨人，
以換回芙蕾雅。
洛基欺騙了阿爾貝里希，
偷走了他的指環與力量。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ABut Alberich cursed his ring
Before it was returned to him,
Envy and death would
befall its wearers.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A但阿爾貝里希詛咒了他的指環，
在它被歸還給他之前，
嫉妒與死亡將降臨於佩戴者。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AThe ring was given to the giants
Freya was returned to the gods
The giants killed themselves
Fighting over the rheingold,
Victims of
Alberich's curse~^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A指環被交給了巨人，
芙蕾雅被歸還給了眾神，
巨人們為了萊茵黃金自相殘殺，
成為了阿爾貝里希詛咒的受害者~^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
This old song
is about the ring
of the Nibelungs.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
嗯...^333333*咳咳*^000000這首古老的歌是關於尼伯龍根的指環。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
Hah... I can't sing more than one song nowadays. But did you like it? ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
^333333*咳咳*^000000哈...我現在一次只能唱一首歌了。
不過你喜歡嗎？^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah...
I do feel like singing a song. You know, every song has its own story. ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
啊...我確實想唱首歌。
你知道嗎，每首歌都有它自己的故事。^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFKino Kitty coughed a few times, wiping his mouth with his sleeve. As he adjusts the guitar strings, you notice small stains of blood on his sleeve. Then, he began to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基諾·基蒂咳了幾聲，用袖子擦了擦嘴。當他調整吉他琴絃時，你注意到他的袖口上有幾處血跡。隨後，他開始歌唱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ABrave hero Siegfried 
Vanquished a mighty dragon	
Its blood coated his skin
Making it impenetrable
Save for one tender spot
Blocked by a single leaf
From a linden tree.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A英勇的英雄齊格飛擊敗了一條強大的巨龍，
龍血塗滿了他的全身，使他刀槍不入，
只有一處柔軟的弱點，
被一片椴樹葉擋住了。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ASiegfried was powerful
Clearly invincible, save for
those who knew of his secret.
In the end he was killed, by
A spear flung into his back
set into motion by the wrath
And jealousy of a woman.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A齊格飛強大無比，
幾乎刀槍不入，
除了那些知道他秘密的人。
最終，他被殺死了，
一支長矛刺入他的後背，
由一個女人的憤怒與嫉妒所驅使。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Bravo, Bravo~!
Uncle Kino is the best Bard in the world~! Jorti likes Uncle Kino's singing!
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
太棒了，太棒了~！
基諾叔叔是世界上最棒的詩人~！
約爾蒂喜歡基諾叔叔的歌聲！

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Thank you, Jorti.
Anytime for my
little princess.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
謝謝你，約爾蒂。
隨時為你服務，我的小公主。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
This song is about Sigfried, who was invincible, except for a single spot on his back. Just singing this reminds me of the influence women have over the world.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
這首歌是關於齊格飛的，他刀槍不入，除了背上的一個弱點。光是唱這首歌，就讓我想起了女性對世界的影響。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You want to
listen to a story?
Mmm, let me think...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你想聽個故事嗎？
嗯，讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go venture Southwest from Morocc, you will arrive at Fortress Sandarman. Did you know that the fortress is built on a sand hill, which serves as a natural defense?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
如果你從夢羅克向西南方向前進，就會到達桑德曼要塞。你知道嗎，這座要塞建在一個沙丘上，這構成了天然的防禦？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go South of Sandarman, you will see Paros Lighthouse. East from the Lighthouse, you will see Kokomo Beach. North of the beach is Papuchica Forest.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
在桑德曼的南邊，你會看到帕羅斯燈塔。從燈塔往東，你會看到剋剋魔海邊。在海灘的北邊是帕普奇卡森林。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm not boring you, am I? I just wanted to tell you about the village of Umbala, which is above that last place I was telling you about. Have you ever been there?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我沒在無聊地嘮叨吧？我只是想告訴你關於汶巴拉村莊的事，它就在剛才提到的那個地方的上方。你去過那裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Umbala itself is a pretty interesting place. But I'm really interested in this giant tree in Umbala. I've heard that it leads to Niffheim...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
汶巴拉本身是個挺有趣的地方。但我對汶巴拉的那棵巨樹更感興趣。我聽說它通往尼弗海姆...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
Could that tree be Yggdrasil? Is it possible that I could meet her in the Niffheim, realm of the dead?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我在想...那棵樹會是世界樹嗎？
有沒有可能在死者之國尼弗海姆遇見她？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh... Well, I have a chronic disease so I can't speak out loud. I, um, even cough up a little blood. But aside from that, I'm perfectly healthy.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
哦...嗯，我患有慢性病，所以不能大聲說話。我，嗯，甚至還會咳出一點血。但除此之外，我身體很健康。

scripts.text: ^3355FFA look of bitterness momentarily flashed across Kino Kitty's face. He then adjusted his guitar strings and began to play, humming a low tune.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基諾·基蒂的臉上閃過一絲苦澀。隨後他調整了吉他琴絃，開始彈奏，低聲哼唱著一段旋律。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...?
I wish everyone in the world were as kind and honest as you. If that were the case, there'd be no selfish fights. Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
嗯...？
我希望世界上每個人都像你一樣善良誠實。
如果是那樣，就不會有自私的爭鬥了。
哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Everything will be
fine in the end, right?
I'll be okay, Jorti will be okay, and she'll be... Oh.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
一切最終都會好起來的，對吧？
我會沒事的，約爾蒂也會沒事的，她也會...哦。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm sorry, I was just
muttering to myself.
Is there anything
you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
抱歉，我剛才只是在自言自語。
你有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me a story, or sing something~
scripts.translation: 給我講個故事，或者唱首歌~

scripts.text: Your voice is...
scripts.translation: 你的聲音

scripts.text: No thanks. I appreciate it, though.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝你的好意

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah...
I do feel like singing a song. You know, every song has its own story. ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
啊...我確實想唱首歌。
你知道嗎，每首歌都有它自己的故事。^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFKino Kitty coughed a few times, wiping his mouth with his sleeve. As he adjusts the guitar strings, you notice small stains of blood on his sleeve. Then, he began to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基諾·基蒂咳了幾聲，用袖子擦了擦嘴。當他調整吉他琴絃時，你注意到他的袖口上有幾處血跡。隨後，他開始歌唱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ABrave hero Siegfried 
Vanquished a mighty dragon
Its blood coated his skin
Making it impenetrable
Save for one tender spot
Blocked by a single leaf
From a linden tree.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A英勇的英雄齊格飛
擊敗了一條強大的巨龍。
龍血覆滿他的皮膚，
使他刀槍不入，
唯有一處柔軟的弱點，
被一片椴樹葉
遮擋住了。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ASiegfried was powerful
Clearly invincible, save for
those who knew of his secret.
In the end he was killed, by
A spear flung into his back
set into motion by the wrath
And jealousy of a woman.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A齊格飛強大無比，
幾乎刀槍不入，
除了那些知道他秘密的人。
最終，他被殺死了，
一支長矛刺入他的後背，
由一個女人的憤怒與嫉妒所驅使。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Bravo, Bravo~!
Uncle Kino is the best Bard in the world~! Jorti likes Uncle Kino's singing!
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
太棒了，太棒了~！
基諾叔叔是世界上最棒的詩人~！
約爾蒂喜歡基諾叔叔的歌聲！

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Thank you, Jorti.
Anytime for my
little princess.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
謝謝你，約爾蒂。
隨時為你服務，我的小公主。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
This song is about Sigfried, who was invincible, except for a single spot on his back. Just singing this reminds me of the influence women have over the world.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
這首歌是關於齊格飛的，他刀槍不入，除了背上的一個弱點。光是唱這首歌，就讓我想起了女性對世界的影響。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah...
I do feel like singing a song. You know, every song has its own story. ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
啊...我確實想唱首歌。
你知道嗎，每首歌都有它自己的故事。^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFKino Kitty coughed a few times, wiping his mouth with his sleeve. As he adjusts the guitar strings, you notice small stains of blood on his sleeve. Then, he began to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基諾·基蒂咳了幾聲，用袖子擦了擦嘴。當他調整吉他琴絃時，你注意到他的袖口上有幾處血跡。隨後，他開始歌唱。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AI still remember feeling
Your shoulder's warmth
As I leaned on it.
You held my hands
until the final moment.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我仍記得那時的感覺，
你肩膀的溫暖，
當我靠在上面時。
你握著我的手，
直到最後一刻。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1ACrying on the inside,
I saw you off with a smile.
Things would never be the same,
But I'd remember every single
Moment we shared.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我在心中哭泣，卻面帶微笑為你送行。
一切都將不再相同，
但我會銘記我們共度的每一刻。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AI still remember the clear chimes
Of the Prontera Church Bells
The ice cream we shared in Morocc,
Being chased by bats
In Payon dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我仍記得普隆德拉教堂清脆的鐘聲，
我們在夢羅克分享的冰淇淋，
以及在斐揚地牢裡被蝙蝠追逐的日子。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AGazing together at
Comodo's fireworks
Snuggles under the
Gently falling Lutie
Snowflakes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A一起凝望
剋剋魔海邊的煙花，
依偎在薑餅城
輕柔飄落的雪花下...^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AYour beautiful soul
Will be with Odin.
When the day
Of the dusk comes,
A brand new place
Will be before your eyes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A你美麗的靈魂
將與奧丁同在。
當黃昏降臨的那一天，
一片嶄新的天地
將展現在你眼前。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AI will remember you forever.
Forget me not, call my name.
I'll hear you, and look to the skies.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A我會永遠記得你。
勿忘我，呼喚我的名字。
我會聽見，並仰望天空。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Ah, Uncle Kino, isn't this the song my mom always sang? Sing more songs, please! Please~!
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
啊，基諾叔叔，這不是媽媽以前常唱的歌嗎？請再唱幾首吧！拜託了~！

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You're right...
She always used to sing this song... ^333333*Cough*^000000 There are always people waiting for their beloved to return...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你說得對...她以前總是唱這首歌... ^333333*咳咳*^000000 總有人在等待心愛的人歸來...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
If you have someone who you've left behind, someone that is waiting for you, make sure you come back to that person. You'll regret it if you don't.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
如果你心裡有牽掛的人，有在等你的人，一定要回到他們身邊。如果不這樣做，你會後悔的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You want to
listen to a story?
Mmm, let me think...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你想聽個故事嗎？
嗯，讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go venture Southwest from Morocc, you will arrive at Fortress Sandarman. Did you know that the fortress is built on a sand hill, which serves as a natural defense?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
如果你從夢羅克向西南方向前進，就會到達桑德曼要塞。你知道嗎，這座要塞建在一個沙丘上，這構成了天然的防禦？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When you go South of Sandarman, you will see Paros Lighthouse. East from the Lighthouse, you will see Kokomo Beach. North of the beach is Papuchica Forest.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
在桑德曼的南邊，你會看到帕羅斯燈塔。從燈塔往東，你會看到剋剋魔海邊。在海灘的北邊是帕普奇卡森林。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I'm not boring you, am I? I just wanted to tell you about the village of Umbala, which is above that last place I was telling you about. Have you ever been there?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我沒在無聊地嘮叨吧？我只是想告訴你關於汶巴拉村莊的事，它就在剛才提到的那個地方的上方。你去過那裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Umbala itself is a pretty interesting place. But I'm really interested in this giant tree in Umbala. I've heard that it leads to Niffheim...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
汶巴拉本身是個挺有趣的地方。但我對汶巴拉的那棵巨樹更感興趣。我聽說它通往尼弗海姆...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
Could that tree be Yggdrasil? Is it possible that I could meet her in the Niffheim, realm of the dead?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我在想...那棵樹會是世界樹嗎？
有沒有可能在死者之國尼弗海姆遇見她？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh... Well, I have a chronic disease so I can't speak out loud. I, um, even cough up a little blood. But aside from that, I'm perfectly healthy.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
哦...嗯，我患有慢性病，所以不能大聲說話。我，嗯，甚至還會咳出一點血。但除此之外，我身體很健康。

scripts.text: ^3355FFA look of bitterness momentarily flashed across Kino Kitty's face. He then adjusted his guitar strings and began to play, humming a low tune.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基諾·基蒂的臉上閃過一絲苦澀。隨後他調整了吉他琴絃，開始彈奏，低聲哼唱著一段旋律。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...?
I wish everyone in the world were as kind and honest as you. If that were the case, there'd be no selfish fights. Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
嗯...？
我希望世界上每個人都像你一樣善良誠實。
如果是那樣，就不會有自私的爭鬥了。
哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Errende must be waiting for you. Although others would be in anguish if they were made to wait, and people like Errende and me wouldn't mind, it's still more polite to hurry when you can.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
艾倫德一定在等你。別人等久了可能會難受，但像艾倫德和我這樣的人並不在意。不過，還是早點回去比較有禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I guess you've met Mr. Sketzi.
By the way, why do you have that look on your face? Didn't find what you were looking for? Haha, would you show me your left hand?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我想你見過斯凱齊先生吧。
順便問一下，你這是什麼表情？
沒找到想要的東西嗎？
哈哈，能讓我看看你的左手嗎？

scripts.text: Here you go.
scripts.translation: 給您

scripts.text: Um... No!

[Kino Kitty]
Well, while you were gone,
I remembered the original lyrics to the song. I guess they really are important.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
好吧，你不在的時候，我想起了這首歌原來的歌詞。
看來它們真的很重要。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Here, let me give you a letter with the lyrics to Errende. I should also give you my seal so that Errende will know it's me. You don't mind, do you?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
給你，這是一封寫給艾倫德的信，裡面寫著歌詞。我也應該把我的印章給你，這樣艾倫德就知道是我寫的。你不介意吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I mind!
scripts.translation: 是的，我介意！

scripts.text: No, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 不，我不介意

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Ah, right.
You already have a seal marked by Errende. Oh well, if you don't want it, what can I do?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
啊，對了。
你已經有艾倫德標記的印章了。
好吧，如果你不想要，我也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Now, let's see...
How is it supposed to go?
...Lu lu lu...
...La la la...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
那麼，讓我想想...這首歌該怎麼唱呢？
...Lu lu lu...
...La la la...

scripts.text:
^D43D1AAt One, I fall in love.
At Two, you give me your smile.
At Three, I adore your touch.
At Four, a tender kiss.
At Five, we change our minds.
A petal scatters through the air.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A一見，我墜入愛河。
二見，你對我微笑。
三見，我迷戀你的觸碰。
四見，溫柔的親吻。
五見，我們改變了心意。
一片花瓣在空中飄落。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AAt Six, I fall in love~
At Seven, you fall in love~
At Eight, we're both in love.
At Nine, you know my heart.
At Ten, I know you've
been waiting for me.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A六見，我墜入愛河~
七見，你墜入愛河~
八見，我們都墜入愛河。
九見，你讀懂了我的心。
十見，我知道你一直在等我。^000000

scripts.text:
^D43D1AAt Eleven, a precious
Whisper: 'Will you marry me?'
At Twelve, our two hearts
Are one. 12 petals, our
Love finally blossoms.^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A十一見，珍貴的低語：“你願意嫁給我嗎？”
十二見，我們兩顆心合二為一。
十二片花瓣，我們的愛終於綻放。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAfter the song, Kino smiles at you. You feel a sharp pain on your wrist. On the spot where the silver crescent was, you see a tiny black cross.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF歌曲結束後，基諾對你微笑。你感到手腕一陣刺痛。原本銀色新月印記的地方，出現了一個小小的黑色十字。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
So, how do you like it? Well, I'm certain that Errende will love it for sure. Hahahahaha~ ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
怎麼樣，喜歡嗎？我相信艾倫德一定會喜歡的。哈哈哈哈哈~ ^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I want to apologize.
I didn't mean to make you wait, but I just remembered the old lyrics to the song. Now, hurry to Errende, I'm sure he's waiting.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我想向你道歉。
我不是故意讓你久等的，只是突然想起了這首歌的舊歌詞。
現在，快去艾倫德那裡吧，我相信他正在等你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFKino Kitty hands you a letter that is labeled 'Dear Errende'
on the front.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基諾·基蒂遞給你一封信，信封上寫著“致艾倫德”。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmmm...?
There's no reason to be scared.
I mean, I won't bite or anything.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
嗯...？
沒什麼好怕的。
我是說，我又不會咬人什麼的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Didn't you leave already?
I'm sure you can find the lyrics in a bookstore in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你不是已經走了嗎？
我相信你可以在朱諾的書店裡找到歌詞。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Well, I'm sure Errende knows more about bookstores, so he can probably tell you where to look in Juno. Why don't you ask Errende?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
嗯，我相信艾倫德對書店更瞭解，他應該能告訴你在朱諾哪裡找。你為什麼不去問問艾倫德呢？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
If you don't mind, please come again and listen to this poor Bard's songs. I'll prepare a song just for you.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
如果你不介意的話，請再來聽聽這位可憐詩人的歌吧。我會專門為你準備一首歌。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Don't worry about my health. I'm a Bard at heart, and I can't help but sing for my audience.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
別擔心我的健康。我內心是個詩人，忍不住要為觀眾歌唱。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Also, I'd like to thank you for helping Errende. He may be a little whiny, but he's a good person.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
另外，我想感謝你對艾倫德的幫助。他可能有點愛抱怨，但他是個好人。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
A silver seal...?
Well, welcome to the wanderer's club. I must say, the silver crescent suits you.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
銀色印章...？
嗯，歡迎加入流浪者俱樂部。
不得不說，銀色新月很適合你。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
If you have that seal, Mr. Sketzi will permit you to read his books full of Norse songs.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
如果你持有那個印章，斯凱齊先生會允許你閱讀他那些充滿北歐歌謠的書。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
What business
do you have with me,
my friend?
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
朋友，你找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou gave candy to the crying little girl, and relate the problem with the lyrics to Kino Kitty.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你給了哭泣的小女孩糖果，並向基諾·基蒂講述了歌詞的問題。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...
I'm insulted that Errende does not like the words I wrote for 'At One, I Fall in Love.' But, I suppose he is a romantic at heart.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
嗯...艾倫德不喜歡我為《一見鍾情》寫的詞，這讓我很受傷。
不過，我想他內心是個浪漫主義者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
Do you know the
original words
for the song?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼...你知道這首歌的原始歌詞嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
The original lyrics were horrible. There's not enough room in my mind to remember so romantic nonsense. ^333333*Cries*...^000000
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
原始歌詞很糟糕。我的腦海裡沒有空間去記住那些浪漫的胡話。 ^333333*Cries*...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Romance is for foolish dreamers!
I refuse to sing or even remember such vapid lyrics!
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
浪漫是愚蠢的夢想家的專利！
我拒絕演唱甚至記住那些空洞的歌詞！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-uncle Kino
You're scaring me.
Please don't yell!
It makes me want
to cry...
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
基...基諾叔叔你嚇到我了。
請不要大喊！
這讓我想哭...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh...
I'm sorry, princess.
It won't happen again.
Your Unclde Kino will
try to be good
from now on.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
哦...對不起，公主。
不會再發生了。
你的基諾叔叔以後會盡量表現好的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
*Sigh...*
Alright, listen.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
*嘆氣...*好了，聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You'll need an old book of edda lyrics for the original words to the song. All the new books no longer contain the original version.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你需要一本記錄著埃達歌詞的古舊書籍，才能找到這首歌的原始歌詞。所有的新書裡都不再收錄原始版本了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
How did Errende happen to know the original lyrics? In any case, I'm sorry about all this. I suppose I'm a little jaded.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我在想...艾倫德是怎麼知道原始歌詞的？
不管怎樣，我很抱歉發生了這一切。
我想我有點世故了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You know, maybe you should go to Juno. There's a small book store on the book street, and you can probably find the song in that store.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你知道嗎，也許你應該去朱諾。在書街上有一家小書店，你大概能在那家店裡找到那首歌。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333^333333*Cough Cough*^000000^000000
Wh-why do I have to suffer? Are my final days as a Bard on this earth soon approaching? I feel so pathetic...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
^333333^333333*咳咳*^000000^000000為...為什麼我要受這種苦？
我作為吟遊詩人在世的日子快要結束了嗎？
我覺得自己好可憐...

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 給我講個故事

scripts.text: Sing a song.
scripts.translation: 唱一首歌

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
A story? Mmmm...
My throat hurts,
but if you listen,
I will do my best
to relate a tale.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
故事？
嗯...我的喉嚨很痛，但如果你願意聽，我會盡力講一個故事。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Do you know how Baldur, son of Odin, died? There is a story involving his obsessive mother
and the wicked god, Loki.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你知道奧丁的兒子巴德爾是怎麼死的嗎？
有一個故事，涉及他痴迷的母親和邪惡的神洛基。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
One night, Baldur had a nightmare where he was cast into the pit of Hell. Upon hearing of this, Baldur's mother Frigg was stricken with panic.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
一天晚上，巴德爾做了一個夢，夢見自己掉進了地獄的深淵。聽到這個訊息後，巴德爾的母親弗麗嘉驚慌失措。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
To prevent tragedy from befalling her son, she made every single object on earth to agree to an oath where they would not harm Baldur.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
為了不讓悲劇降臨到兒子身上，她讓世間萬物都立下誓言，承諾不會傷害巴德爾。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000 And they all got together to ^333333*Wheeeeze*^000000 celebr--^333333^333333*Cough*^000000^000000...

[Jorti]
Uncle Kino...?
Are you okay?....?
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
基諾叔叔...？
你還好嗎？...？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
...Hah...
...Hah...
I'm sorry, but I don't think I can speak for much longer.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
...哈...
...哈...
抱歉，我想我沒法再說太久了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Sorry, but I don't feel like singing at the moment. I hope you understand. I want to sing the last song of my life for Jorti...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
抱歉，我現在不想唱歌。希望你能理解。我想為約爾蒂唱我生命中的最後一首歌...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You have no
business with me?
What a shame.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你和我沒什麼關係？
真遺憾。

scripts.text:
^D43D1AEven in the sandy wind,
Even in the pouring rain,
Even in the falling snow,
I know it's you~^000000
scripts.translation:
^D43D1A即使在沙風中，
即使在傾盆大雨中，
即使在飄落的雪花中，
我知道是你~^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
...
......

[Mysterious Bard]
My apologies,
^333333*Cough*^000000 but this is
a private performance
for my little
princess.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
抱歉，^333333*咳咳*^000000 但這是為我小公主的私人演出。

scripts.text: Um, was that a love song?
scripts.translation: 嗯，那是一首情歌嗎？

scripts.text: I'm sorry for interrupting you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打擾了

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
A...
Love song?!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
什...什麼？
情歌？！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Love songs are for fools who have never known true love, or never had their hearts broken. Happy songs are fine, but I refuse to sing nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
情歌是那些從未體驗過真愛，或者從未心碎過的傻瓜才唱的。歡快的歌沒問題，但我拒絕唱那些胡言亂語！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Waaaah~!
Uncle Kino,
I'm scared!
I wanna see
my mommy...!
*Cries*
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
哇~!
基諾叔叔，我好害怕！
我想找媽媽...！
*Cries*

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There, there,
princess. Don't cry.
Everything's okay.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
乖，乖，小公主。
別哭了。
一切都會沒事的。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be scared. The scary people with swords only use them on monsters, okay?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
沒什麼好怕的。那些拿著劍的可怕的人，只會對魔物使用它們，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
You don't need to be scared, that person is a servant of God, okay?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
不用害怕，那個人是神的僕人，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be afraid of this riffraff, your Uncle Kino is here, okay?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
不用怕這些粗人，你的基諾叔叔在這裡呢，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be afraid. I know that person looks scary, but you're a good girl, so you'll be okay.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
沒什麼好怕的。我知道那個人看起來很兇，但你是個好孩子，所以你會沒事的。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be scared, honey. It's just a Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
沒什麼好怕的，親愛的。那只是個鐵匠而已。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
There's no reason to be scared. See...? That person won't hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
沒什麼好怕的。看...？那個人不會傷害你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
^333333(Wasn't the little girl
scared by your outburst...?)^000000

[Mysterious Bard]
You're such a kind, young person. I will remember your name. I would much appreciate it if you would also remember mine.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
你真是個善良的年輕人。我會記住你的名字。如果你也能記住我的名字，我會非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
I am known as Kino Kitty. I am a wandering poet who wishes to rediscover wishes and dreams.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
人們叫我基諾·基蒂。我是一名流浪詩人，希望重新找回人們心中的願望與夢想。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When next we meet, I will tell you what I have heard and experienced. That is, I am willing to spend my time with you.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
下次見面時，我會告訴你我所聽到和經歷的事情。也就是說，我願意與你共度時光。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When next we meet, I will tell you what I have heard and experienced. That is, I am willing to spend my time with you.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
下次見面時，我會告訴你我所聽到和經歷的事情。也就是說，我願意與你共度時光。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Oh, you're most admirable. You truly do respect Bards, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
哦，你真是令人欽佩。你真的很尊重詩人，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Now that I think about it, are you look for anything, or is there a reason you wish to speak to me?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
現在想想，你是在找什麼東西，還是有什麼事想和我說？

scripts.text: I'm looking for Kino Kitty...
scripts.translation: 我在找基諾·基蒂

scripts.text: Nothing, really.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別的

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
How do you
know my name?
Ah, I'm flattered
that my reputation
precedes me.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你怎麼知道我的名字？
啊，我的名聲竟然先於我傳開了，真讓我受寵若驚。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou give some candy to the crying girl and relate your tale regarding the lyrics for the song 'At One, I Fall in Love.'^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你給了哭泣的小女孩一些糖果，並講述了關於歌曲《一見鍾情》歌詞的故事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Hmm...
I'm insulted that Errende does not like the words I wrote for 'At One, I Fall in Love.' But, I suppose he is a romantic at heart.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
嗯...艾倫德不喜歡我為《一見鍾情》寫的詞，這讓我很受傷。
不過，我想他內心是個浪漫主義者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
Do you know the
original words
for the song?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼...你知道這首歌的原始歌詞嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
The original lyrics were horrible. There's not enough room in my mind to remember so romantic nonsense. ^333333*Cries*...^000000
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
原始歌詞很糟糕。我的腦海裡沒有空間去記住那些浪漫的胡話。 ^333333*Cries*...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Romance is for foolish dreamers! I refuse to sing or even remember such vapid lyrics!
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
浪漫是愚蠢的夢想家才有的東西！我拒絕演唱，甚至拒絕回憶那些空洞的歌詞！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-uncle Kino
You're scaring me.
Please don't yell!
It makes me want
to cry...
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
基...基諾叔叔你嚇到我了。
請不要大喊！
這讓我想哭...

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
Oh...
I'm sorry, princess. It won't happen again. Your Unclde Kino will try to be good from now on.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
啊...對不起，公主。
我不會再這樣了。
基諾叔叔以後會努力表現的。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
*Sigh...*
Alright, listen.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
*嘆氣...*好了，聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You'll need an old book of edda lyrics for the original words to the song. All the new books no longer contain the original version.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你需要一本記錄著埃達歌詞的古舊書籍，才能找到這首歌的原始歌詞。所有的新書裡都不再收錄原始版本了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
I wonder...
How did Errende happen to know the original lyrics? In any case, I'm sorry about all this. I supposed I'm a little jaded.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
我在想...艾倫德怎麼會知道原始歌詞呢？
不管怎樣，對於這一切我很抱歉。
我想我大概是有些世故了。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You know, maybe you should go to Juno. There's a small book store on the book street, and you can probably find the song in that store.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你知道嗎，也許你應該去朱諾。在書街上有一家小書店，你大概能在那家店裡找到那首歌。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
^333333^333333*Cough Cough*^000000^000000
Wh-why do I have to suffer? Are my final days as a Bard on this earth soon approaching? I feel so pathetic...
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
^333333^333333*咳咳*^000000^000000為...為什麼我要受這種苦？
我作為吟遊詩人在世的日子快要結束了嗎？
我覺得自己好可憐...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Really now?
That's strange.
You adventurers are always one some kind of adventure, aren't you? I mean, that's the very definition of the word.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
真的嗎？
真奇怪。
你們冒險者總是在進行某種冒險，不是嗎？
畢竟，這就是這個詞的定義。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
You're such a nice young man. I will remember your name. I would much appreciate it if you would also remember mine.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
你真是個不錯的年輕男子。我會記住你的名字。如果你也能記住我的名字，我會非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
I am known as Kino Kitty. I am a wandering poet who wishes to rediscover wishes and dreams.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
人們叫我基諾·基蒂。我是一名流浪詩人，渴望重新發現願望和夢想。

scripts.text:
[Kino Kitty]
When next we meet, I will tell you what I have heard and experienced. That is, I am willing to spend my time with you.
scripts.translation:
[基諾·基蒂]
下次見面時，我會告訴你我所聽到和經歷的事情。也就是說，我願意與你共度時光。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Ah, it is a privilege to meet a noble woman such as yourself. By your leave, I shall give you my name.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
啊，能結識像您這樣高貴的女士是我的榮幸。請允許我向您介紹我的名字。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
My lady, fair as wisteria, whose beauty rivals that of the goddess Freya, let me introduce myself as the poor poet who wanders the earth, Kino Kitty. I hope you remember me.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
美麗如紫藤的女士，您的美貌可與女神芙蕾雅相媲美。請允許我自我介紹，我是流浪於大地的貧窮詩人，基諾·基蒂。希望您能記住我。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Jorti tries not to cry anymore because it hurts Uncle Kino and then he coughs up more blood.
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
約爾蒂試著不再哭了，因為那樣會讓基諾叔叔難受，然後他會咳出更多的血。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
I miss my mommy a lot, but I'm worried, it makes Uncle Kino worry a lot too.
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
我很想念媽媽，但我擔心這樣會讓基諾叔叔也很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
I don't see my mommy and daddy aren't here anymore, and I don't want Uncle Jorti to go away either.
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
媽媽和爸爸都不在了，我也不想讓基諾叔叔離開。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Um, I don't remember my daddy, but mommy lives far away, somewhere near the sky. That's what Uncle Kino says.
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
嗯，我不記得爸爸了，但媽媽住在很遠的地方，靠近天空的地方。基諾叔叔是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-Uncle Kino says we can't go see her yet because there are no flying boats yet...
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
基...基諾叔叔說我們還不能去看她，因為還沒有飛艇...

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
La la la...
La la la...
Jorti doesn't cry anymore!
Jorti is going to enjoy Uncle Kino's songs and stories for as long as she can!
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
La la la...
La la la...
約爾蒂不再哭了！
約爾蒂要儘可能長久地享受基諾叔叔的歌和故事！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
The songs Uncle Kino sings are ones that my mommy used to sing. She's not here, but maybe we can visit her someday!
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
基諾叔叔唱的歌是媽媽以前常唱的。雖然她不在了，但也許有一天我們可以去見她！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Hey... The shiny black cross on your hand means you're a friend of Uncle Kino's. So that means, you're my friend too!
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
嘿...你手上那個閃亮的黑色十字架，說明你是基諾叔叔的朋友。那也就是說，你也是我的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Jorti tries not to cry anymore because it hurts Uncle Kino and then he coughs up more blood.
I miss my mommy a lot, but when I'm worried, it makes Uncle Kino worry a lot too.
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
約爾蒂試著不再哭了，因為那樣會讓基諾叔叔難受，然後他會咳出更多的血。
我很想念媽媽，但當我擔心的時候，基諾叔叔也會很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
My mommy and daddy aren't here anymore, and I don't want Uncle Jorti to go away either.
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
我的媽媽和爸爸都不在了，我也不想讓基諾叔叔離開。

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Um, I don't remember my daddy, but mommy lives far away, somewhere near the sky. That's what Uncle Kino says.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
U-Uncle Kino says we can't go see her yet because there are no flying boats yet...
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
基...基諾叔叔說我們還不能去看她，因為還沒有飛艇...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Even in the sandy wind,
Even in the pouring rain,
Even in the falling snow,
I know it's--
........
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
即使在沙風中，
即使在傾盆大雨中，
即使在飄落的雪花中，
我知道那是--
........

scripts.text:
[Jorti]
Uncle...?
Are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[約爾蒂]
叔叔...？
你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Bard]
Hmmm...
I'm sorry, but this is a private performance. This song is only intended for my little Jorti.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的吟遊詩人]
嗯...抱歉，這是一場私人演出。
這首歌只唱給我的小約爾蒂聽。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Well, did you find what you were seeking for? Although all we have are old, dusty books, I hope you come by to visit. And please give my regards to your Bard friends.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
那麼，你找到你尋找的東西了嗎？雖然這裡只有些落滿灰塵的舊書，但我還是希望你能常來坐坐。另外，請代我向你的詩人朋友們問好。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Interesting...
You have a black cross seal on your hand. Is Kitty still around? I'm glad to see he's still alive. If you're a friend of his, then you are most welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
有意思...你手上有一個黑色的十字印記。
基諾·基蒂還在附近嗎？
很高興看到他還活著。
既然你是他的朋友，那麼這裡歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Well, well, well. You're here again. So, what kind of books are you seeking today? Of course, all we have are old, dusty tomes full of eddas. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。你又來了。那麼，今天你想找什麼樣的書呢？當然，我們這裡只有些落滿灰塵、寫滿埃達集的舊書。哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Welcome.
You must be looking for something special. Well, we have almost every Norse poem, or 'edda.' This is the only place where you can find those kinds of old songs.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
歡迎光臨。
你一定是在尋找什麼特別的東西吧。
嗯，我們這裡幾乎收藏了所有的北歐詩歌，也就是“埃達集”。
這裡是唯一能找得到這類古老歌謠的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
However, I cannot show these fragile books to just anybody. For the sake of preservation, I can only show these works to preferred customers.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
不過，我不能把這些脆弱的書籍隨便展示給任何人看。為了儲存它們，我只能向特定的顧客展示這些作品。

scripts.text: Show him your left hand.
scripts.translation: 展示你的左手

scripts.text: Show him your right hand.
scripts.translation: 展示你的右手

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Ah~! You must be the friend of a high ranking Bard! I see, I see. You must be a friend of Minty Errende.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
啊~！你一定是位高階詩人的朋友！我明白了，我明白了。你一定是薄荷·艾倫德的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
So, what is it that you're looking for? Well, I suppose I don't really need to ask that. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
那麼，你在找什麼呢？嗯，我想我其實不需要問這個問題。哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Please...
Take your time.
I hope you find
what you're
looking for.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
請...慢慢看。
希望你能找到你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Let's see... Okay.
Well, your heartbeat is a little faster than normal. You might want to look into that. You know, for the sake of your health?
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
讓我看看...好的。
嗯，你的心跳比平時快一點。
你可能需要關注一下這方面。
你知道的，為了你的健康著想？

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
You're not looking for any medical or health related books, are you? I'm sorry, but we don't carry any of those.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
你是在找醫療或健康方面的書嗎？很抱歉，我們這裡沒有這類書。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
Welcome.
You must be looking for something special and rare. But we only carry one kind of book around here.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
歡迎光臨。
你一定是在尋找什麼特別且稀有的東西。
但我們這裡只有一種書。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
If you're looking for monster information, why don't you check the Pronrera Library or the Monster Museum here in Juno?
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
如果你是在找魔物資訊，為什麼不看看普隆德拉圖書館，或者朱諾這裡的魔物博物館呢？

scripts.translation: ^3355FF你打開了書。書頁有些脆硬，字跡已經褪色，幾乎難以辨認。你甚至無法辨認出作者的名字。^000000

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
This is a love song. Everyone suffers from unrequited love at least once in their lifetime.
scripts.translation:
[埃達集]
這是一首情歌。每個人一生中至少都會經歷一次單戀的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
At One, I fall in love.
At Two, you give me your smile.
At Three, I adore your touch.
At Four, a tender kiss...
scripts.translation:
[埃達集]
一見，我墜入愛河。
二見，你對我微笑。
三見，我迷戀你的觸碰。
四見，溫柔的親吻...

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
At Five, we change our minds.
A petal scatters through the air.
At Six, I fall in love~
At Seven, you fall in love...
scripts.translation:
[埃達集]
五見，我們改變了心意。
花瓣在空中飄散。
六見，我再次墜入愛河~
七見，你也墜入愛河...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think this is it...!
I better write it down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想就是這首了...！
我得把它記下來。

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
At Eight, we're both in love.
At Nine, you know my heart.
At Ten, I know you've
been waiting for me.
scripts.translation:
[埃達集]
八見，我們雙雙相愛。
九見，你讀懂了我的心。
十見，我知道你一直在等我。

scripts.text:
[Collection of Eddas]
At Eleven, a precious
Whisper: 'Will you marry me?'
At Twelve, our two hearts
Are one. 12 petals, our
Love finally blossoms.
scripts.translation:
[埃達集]
十一見，珍貴的低語：“你願意嫁給我嗎？”
十二見，我們兩顆心合二為一。
十二片花瓣，我們的愛終於綻放。

scripts.translation:

很抱歉，這本書太脆弱了，不適合翻閱。只有特定的顧客才能查閱這些書籍。

scripts.text:

I, Luke of Izlude, greatest of Bards in my time, leave the lyrics of my essential songs for posterity.
 
Contents
scripts.translation:
