我，依斯魯得的盧克，是我那個時代最偉大的詩人，將我最重要的歌曲歌詞留給後世。
 
目錄

scripts.text: Wedding Song
scripts.translation: 婚禮之歌

scripts.text: Life is a Water Mill
scripts.translation: 人生如水車

scripts.text: We
scripts.translation: 我們

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
Prontera Sanctuary
Is where all are heading
To celebrate your union
At your most happy wedding.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮之歌]
普隆德拉聖堂，
是眾人前往之地，
為你們的結合慶祝，
在這最幸福的婚禮上。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
With joy I strum my Lute
As that is my trade
To bring cheerful song
To your wedding parade.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮之歌]
我歡欣地撥動魯特琴，
這是我的本職，
為你們的婚禮遊行，
送上歡快的歌聲。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
For my songs, pay me
Not Zeny or Gold,
But the smile of the
Bride, if I may
be so bold.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮之歌]
要我的歌聲，請不要付我
Zeny或金幣，
而要新娘的一個微笑，
如果我夠膽大的話。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
The glistening eyes
Of a beautiful lass
Those lustrous locks
And that firm, supple--
scripts.translation:
[婚禮之歌]
閃爍的眼眸，
美麗少女的眼神，
那光澤的秀髮，
還有那堅實而柔韌的——

scripts.text:
[Wedding Song]
Forgive me, groom!
But she's just so beautiful!
May your union be blessed!
Er, may your wife be dutiful.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮之歌]
請原諒我，新郎！
但她實在太美了！
願你們的結合蒙受祝福！
呃，願你的妻子溫順賢惠。

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
This song is about a certain Bard who was invited to a wedding ceremony and could not resist the bride's beauty. He ended up singing a song of seduction.
scripts.translation:
[盧克的筆記]
這首歌是關於一位被邀請參加婚禮的詩人，他無法抗拒新娘的美貌。最後他唱了一首誘惑的歌。

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
The lyrics, of course, are fictional, and are in no way anecdotal.
scripts.translation:
[盧克的筆記]
當然，歌詞是虛構的，並非基於真實事件。

scripts.text:
[Life is a Water Mill]
I chased after fame.
It eluded me.
I ran after happiness
But never caught it.
scripts.translation:
[人生如水車]
我追逐名聲。
它卻離我而去。
我追逐幸福，
卻從未抓住它。

scripts.text:
[Life is a Water Mill]
But tomorrow will still
Be there, I'm sure.
Like the Water Mill
In Al De Baran
Which turns as
Life goes on.
scripts.translation:
[人生如水車]
但我確信，明天依然會到來，
就像艾爾帕蘭的水車，
不停地轉動，
生活還在繼續。

scripts.text:
[Life is a Water Mill]
Cheer up! Life goes on.
As surely as the Water
Mill turns, tomorrow
Will come.
scripts.translation:
[人生如水車]
振作起來！生活還在繼續。
正如水車必定轉動，
明天終將到來。

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
This song was
made to give comfort
to people in despair.
scripts.translation:
[盧克的筆記]
這首歌是為了安慰絕望中的人們而創作的。

scripts.text:
[We]
A good Bard sings
To please his listener.
So do not expect a sad song
That deepens your anguish.
scripts.translation:
[我們]
優秀的詩人歌唱，是為了取悅聽眾。
所以請不要期待悲傷的歌曲，
來加深你的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[We]
A good Dancer dances
To please her audience.
Shall we dance together?
Just hold my hands.
La la la~ La la la~
scripts.translation:
[我們]
優秀的舞娘起舞，是為了取悅觀眾。
我們要一起跳舞嗎？
只需握住我的手。
La la la~ La la la~

scripts.text:
[We]
Towner: 'Then why the hell do you guys make discords sometimes?!'
Bard: 'Well... Nobody's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[我們]
鎮民：“那你們為什麼有時候要弄出不和諧的音？！”
詩人：“嗯...沒有人是完美的嘛！”

scripts.text:
[Luke's Note]
This song is good to be sung during festivals, as the intentional discord encourages the audience to participate. Aside from that, this song is pretty meaningless.
scripts.translation:
[盧克的筆記]
這首歌適合在節日裡演唱，故意加入的不和諧音能鼓勵觀眾參與進來。除此之外，這首歌其實沒什麼特別的意義。

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
I'm sorry, but that book is not available for public exhibition.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
很抱歉，這本書不對外公開展示。

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
This song was written to give courage to soldiers on the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[戰場上的鼓聲]
這首歌是為了鼓舞戰場上計程車兵而創作的。

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
The sounds of galloping
Echo in the distance.
A cloud of hazy dust
scripts.translation:
[戰場上的鼓聲]
馬蹄聲
在遠處迴響。
一片朦朧的塵埃

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Fills the setting sun.
Thousands of eyes open
Torches on the castle
Flare like thousands of Ifrits.
scripts.translation:
[戰場上的鼓聲]
籠罩著落日。
成千上萬雙眼睛睜開。
城堡上的火把
如同成千上萬的伊夫利特般燃燒。

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Hear the throbbing of my heart,
The blood flowing in my veins.
Feeling the heaviness of my armor.
The enemy has appeared before us.
scripts.translation:
[戰場上的鼓聲]
聽我心臟的搏動，
感受血液在血管中奔流。
感受著鎧甲的重量。
敵人已出現在我們面前。

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Beat the drums hard, harder!
Courage, soldiers, march forward!
Shout loud, soldiers, louder!
Today will never come back!
scripts.translation:
[戰場上的鼓聲]
用力敲鼓，更用力！
鼓起勇氣，士兵們，向前衝鋒！
大聲吶喊，士兵們，更響亮！
今天永遠不會再回來！

scripts.text:
[Drumming in the battlefield]
Stun the sky
Provoke the earth,
I feel my heartbeat again.
Blow the bugle to
Sway the fortress.
Today will never come back!
scripts.translation:
[戰場上的鼓聲]
震撼天空，
挑釁大地，
我再次感到心跳加速。
吹響號角，
動搖堡壘。
今天永遠不會再回來！

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
I'm sorry, but that book is not available for public exhibition.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
很抱歉，這本書不對外公開展示。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
This song praises the golden apples of the goddess Idun. These were the source of the God's power, as it prevented them from growing old.
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
這首歌讚美女神伊登的黃金蘋果。這些蘋果是眾神力量的源泉，因為它們能防止眾神衰老。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Every god never grows old
Because of beautiful
Goddess, Idun.
Keeper of the apples of youth
Goddess of immortality.
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
眾神永不衰老，
皆因美麗的女神伊登。
青春之果的守護者，
不朽的女神。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Every god never grows old.
Idun, the wife of Bragi,
Idun, Odin's daughter in law~
The apples she keeps
In her basket.
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
眾神永不衰老。
伊登，布拉基的妻子，
伊登，奧丁的兒媳~
她守護著的蘋果，
盛放在她的籃子裡。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Without Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
沒有伊登，
眾神都將
屈服於衰老。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Even Thor, the strongest of gods,
would grow frail, Megingjard would
slip from his waist, and Mjolnir
would never fly again.
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
即使是眾神中最強的托爾，
也會變得虛弱，雷神腰帶會從腰間滑落，
雷神之錘也將再也無法飛翔。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
Without Idun,
Every god would
have succumbed to age.
Loki was careless once,
and made her lost to the gods.
Loki was forced to get her back.
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
沒有伊登，
眾神都將屈服於衰老。
洛基曾一時疏忽，
讓她與眾神失散。
洛基被迫將她找回。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
My goddess stands
In the field of Asgard
She hands me fruit from heaven.
You will be loved by every god...
You will be blessed
By every god...
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
我的女神佇立
於阿斯加德的原野，
將天界的果實賜予我。
你將受到眾神的喜愛...
你將蒙受眾神的祝福...

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
If you share the
Apple of youth with me
Even a bite of it with
This poor poet.
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
如果你願與我分享
青春之果，
哪怕只讓我這位
窮困的詩人嘗上一口。

scripts.text:
[Apple of Idun]
You will be loved by every god...
You will be blessed
By every god...
scripts.translation:
[伊登之蘋果]
您將受到眾神的喜愛...
您將受到眾神的祝福...

scripts.text:
[Sketzi Bundin]
I'm sorry, but that book is not available for public exhibition.
scripts.translation:
[斯凱齊·邦丁]
很抱歉，這本書不對外公開展示。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Hahaha~!
Listen, listen!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
哈哈哈~!
聽，聽啊！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I was told this song from one of my friends about this Merchant who lives in Payon and everyone loves this song, especially because I'm singing it and you know that...
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
我的一位朋友告訴我，斐揚有一位商人，大家都很喜歡這首歌，尤其是因為是我在唱，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
Are you...
Gunther Doubleharmony?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。
請問你是...岡瑟·雙和諧嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
...the Merchant was so poor he didn't even have--eh? Oh yeah, right. That's me. What's up?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
...那個商人窮得連--呃？哦對，沒錯，就是我。有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou explain that you have come to him, seeking lost song lyrics.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向他解釋，你是來找他尋求丟失的歌詞的。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Ahhhhhhh, I see.
Now, what was the
name of the song again?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
啊哈，我明白了。
那麼，那首歌的名字又是什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Ah~ that song...?
By the way, who asked you
to find out about the song?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
啊~那首歌...？
順便問一下，是誰讓你來打聽這首歌的？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Yes, that's my friend! Minty Errende! We used to so close to each other, so I'll write every word of the song for my friend Minty Errende, so turn around please!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
是的，那是我的朋友！薄荷·艾倫德！我們以前關係很親密，所以我會把這首歌的每一個字都寫給我的朋友薄荷·艾倫德，請轉過身去！

scripts.text: ^3355FFGunther furiously scribbled something upon your back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF岡瑟在你的背上瘋狂地寫寫畫畫。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
There you go! Now you can go back to Minty Errende and show him your back and he will see what I wrote and then remember the lyrics!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
好了！現在你可以回去找薄荷·艾倫德，讓他看看你背上我寫的內容，他就會想起歌詞了！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
No no no, I don't know anyone with that name, so you better go and check the name of the person asking again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
不不不，我不認識叫這個名字的人，所以你最好再去確認一下那個人的名字，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
No no no no, I don't know any song with that title, it might not even exist, so you should go and check the name of the song again and tell me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
不不不不，我不認識有這個名字的歌，它可能根本不存在，所以你應該再去確認一下歌名，然後告訴我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
You came back again!
Huh, the song I wrote on your back? Hold on, hold on, let me think let me--ah, right, I got it!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
你又回來了！
嗯，我寫在你背上的歌？
等一下，等一下，讓我想想，讓我--啊，對了，我想起來了！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
The words I wrote down on your back were written by Mr. Kitty, my idol, my hero! That song is the art of ^228B22Kino Kitty^000000!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
我寫在你背上的那些字，是我偶像、我的英雄基諾·基蒂先生寫的！那首歌是^228B22基諾·基蒂^000000的藝術！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I wish that someday I could be as great a Bard as him!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
我希望有一天我能像他一樣，成為偉大的詩人！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Hahaha~!
Listen, listen!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
哈哈哈~!
聽，聽啊！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I was told this song from one of my friends about this Merchant who lives in Payon and everyone loves this song, especially because I'm singing it and you know that...
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
我的一位朋友告訴我，斐揚有一位商人，大家都很喜歡這首歌，尤其是因為是我在唱，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Oh, right...!
Do you wanna listen
to my song or a story?
I know you want to!
Right, right?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
哦，對了...！
你想聽我的歌還是故事？
我知道你想聽的！
對吧，對吧？

scripts.text: Show some interest.
scripts.translation: 表現出興趣

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Yay~! I knew it!
So you wanna hear
a song or a story?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
耶~！
我就知道！
那麼你想聽歌還是故事？

scripts.text: A song
scripts.translation: 一首歌

scripts.text: A story
scripts.translation: 一個故事

scripts.text: Maybe some other time
scripts.translation: 改天再說

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Gunther sings!
Gunther dances!
The tile of this song is~
'The Rich Mr. Kim~!'
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
岡瑟要唱歌啦！
岡瑟要跳舞啦！
這首歌的名字是~《富有的金先生~》！

scripts.text:
^228B22Merchant of Payon
So poooooooor~
No money for armor
No money to make.
scripts.translation:
^228B22斐揚的商人，
窮得叮噹響~
沒錢買盔甲，
也沒錢做生意。

scripts.text:
^228B22Sold the
Cotton Shirt
Off his back
No pity he'll take.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22他把棉襯衫
從身上脫下來賣掉，
一點也不心疼。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22First he only sold Red Pots
At first, he only sold red pots.
Then he moved up to Carrots, whoohoo~
He could afford new armor
and even wear it,
whoohoo~^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22起初，他只賣紅藥水。
後來他開始賣胡蘿蔔，哇哦~
他買得起新盔甲，還能穿在身上，
哇哦~^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22But one day, he was scammed
Scammed by a wicked guild.
Made poor once again.
He decided to go to Ant Hell
Right there
And right then.
scripts.translation:
^228B22可有一天，他被騙了，
被一個邪惡的公會騙了。
再次變得一貧如洗。
他決定去螞蟻地獄，
就在那時，就在那裡。

scripts.text:
^228B22Bats, Dwarves, Eggs, Ants!
He battled them all~
Worm Peelings, Jellopy!
He gathered loot great and small.
scripts.translation:
^228B22蝙蝠、矮人、螞蟻蛋、螞蟻！
他與它們全部戰鬥~
蟲皮、傑勒比結晶！
他收集了大大小小的戰利品。

scripts.text:
^228B22Then the glorious day came
When he found a valuable card
That'd bring great wealth to his naaaame~^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22然後，光輝的日子到來了，
他發現了一張珍貴的卡片，
將為他的名號帶來巨大的財富~^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22But he kept it dear to him
To remember his times of
working so hard.
He never sold it, never sold
his precious card~^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22但他把它珍藏在身邊，
用來銘記他辛勤工作的歲月。
他從未賣掉它，從未賣掉
他珍貴的卡片~^000000

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
That's a very old story about rich Mr. Kim, and his rise from rags to riches to rags to riches. Is it true or is it fiction? Oh, please don't ask me! I've no clue!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
這是一個關於富有的金先生，從一無所有到富有，再從富有到一無所有的古老故事。這是真的還是虛構的？哦，請別問我！我完全不知道！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
*Ahem*
Gunther sings 
of Yggdrasil~
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
*咳咳*岡瑟要唱關於世界樹的歌~

scripts.text:
^228B22Evergreen Yggdrasil~
Giant ashen tree
reaching for the sky.
Crystal, morning dew
From its leaves
Formed Urd's Pond.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22常青的世界樹~
巨大的白蠟樹伸向天空。
晶瑩的晨露
從它的葉子上滴落，
匯成了烏爾德之泉。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Three wise girls.
Seated beneath its boughs.
Urd of the past,
Belldandy of the present
Skuld the future.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22三位智慧的女神，
坐在它的枝葉下。
過去的烏爾德，
現在的貝蘭丹迪，
未來的斯庫爾德。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Spinning, weaving
Threads of destiny.
Evergreen Yggdrasil~
Giant ashen tree
reaching for the sky.
Its roots soaked with tears.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22紡織著，編織著
命運的絲線。
常青的世界樹~
巨大的白蠟樹伸向天空。
它的根部浸滿了淚水。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Death in Hvergelmir.
An evil dragon
Burning its roots
With eternal flame.
The evil dragon Nidhogg
Living between Yggdrasil
and Niffheim.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22赫維格爾密爾中的死亡。
一條邪惡的巨龍，
以永恆的火焰焚燒著它的根部。
邪惡的巨龍尼德霍格，
生活在世界樹與尼弗海姆之間。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Evergreen Yggdrasil~
Giant ashen tree
reaching for the sky.
Wisdom in its roots
Roots reaching
Mimir's pond.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22常青的世界樹~
巨大的白蠟樹伸向天空。
它的根部蘊含智慧，
根鬚延伸至米米爾之泉。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22Guarded by a wise giant.
Odin sacrificed one
of his eyes for the wisdom.
Heimdall's horn hidden
In Yggdrasil's roots
Will sound one last time
Signaling Ragnarok.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22由一位智慧的巨人守護。
奧丁為了智慧，
獻出了一隻眼睛。
海姆達爾的號角
隱藏在世界樹的根部，
將最後一次吹響，
預示諸神黃昏。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
This is a very old story...
Is it truth or fiction? But please don't ask me, I have no idea~!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
這是一個非常古老的故事...它是真實還是虛構？
但請別問我，我完全不知道~！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I will sing one of Luke's songs, you know, Luke, one of the greatest Bards of his time? But I changed the words a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
我要唱一首盧克的歌，你知道的，盧克，他那個時代最偉大的詩人之一？不過我把歌詞改了一點點。

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Old, worn letters
Forming elaborate words.
Sincere reflection
Of a sincere mind.^000000
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屜裡發現了它。
古老而磨損的信件，
組成了精緻的詞句。
真摯的反思，
來自一顆真摯的心。^000000

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Was I really like that once?
Was I really that childish?
My memories are tarnished.
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屜裡發現了它。
我曾經真的那樣嗎？
我曾經真的那麼幼稚嗎？
我的回憶已經斑駁。

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Love I had forgotten.
She never got this letter.
But both of us were too shy.
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屜裡發現了它。
那是我早已遺忘的愛。
她從未收到這封信，
但我們倆都太害羞了。

scripts.text:
^228B22I found it in a drawer.
Love I had forgotten.
I never gave her this letter.
But both of us were too proud.
scripts.translation:
^228B22我在抽屜裡發現了它。
那是我早已遺忘的愛。
我從未把這封信交給她，
但我們倆都太驕傲了。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Do you have anyone in mind? Do you? If you ever write a love letter, you must send it and express yourself.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
你有喜歡的人嗎？有嗎？如果你寫了一封情書，一定要寄出去，表達你的心意。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
If you've written love letters that you'll never send, throw them away. Throw your goddamn pride away.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
如果你寫了情書卻從未寄出，那就把它們扔掉吧。把你該死的自尊心也扔掉。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Um, have you ever
tasted Comodo cheese?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
嗯，你嘗過科摩多島的乳酪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
You can only taste it in Comodo, but you need to have a good strong stomach to digest it. Oh! And the cheese has a secret!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
只有在科摩多島才能吃到，但你需要有強健的胃才能消化它。哦！而且這種乳酪還有個秘密！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
You ^228B22might^000000 be invulnerable to the power of the doomed swords, which come from the other world, if you eat it!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
如果你吃了它，^228B22也許^000000就能免疫來自異世界的詛咒之劍的力量！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Why don't you go taste it if you haven't yet? I tried to taste it once. It was kind of yummy, but then I fainted. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
如果你還沒嘗過，為什麼不去嚐嚐呢？我試過一次。味道還不錯，但我隨後就暈倒了。哈哈哈哈~!

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I was passing Prontera the other day at the place where it used to be the Swordman training ground.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
前幾天我路過普隆德拉，就是以前劍士訓練場的那個地方。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I saw some kid training really really hard and he didn't notice me watching him, so I guess he was really really serious!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
我看到一個小男孩在非常非常努力地訓練，他都沒注意到我在看他，看來他是真的非常非常認真！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
He looked like he wanted to be a professional Swordman, but he was also giving his gear away to other Novices.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
他看起來想成為職業劍士，但他也在把自己的裝備送給其他初心者。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
I got bored watching him do the same thing over and over and over again, but I think the Monster Research Organization would like him if I introduced him.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
看著他一遍又一遍地重複同樣的動作，我看膩了，但我覺得如果我把他介紹給魔物研究組織，他們應該會喜歡他的。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Have you ever been in Lutie,
land of year round snow?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
你去過薑餅城嗎？
那個終年積雪的地方。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
There is a snowman named
SnowySnow and if you met him, you'd know all sorts of things about him like he can talk! It's so strange and mysterious~!
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
那裡有一個叫雪雪的雪人，如果你見到他，你會知道關於他各種各樣的事情，比如他會說話！
這太奇怪又神秘了~！

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
He has a mysterious bag where endless gifts come out, and he's got a mysterious past involving some colder town and something about a nasty witch.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
他有一個神秘的袋子，裡面能拿出無盡的禮物，而且他有一段神秘的過去，涉及某個更寒冷的城鎮和一個邪惡的女巫。

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
But it's okay because he was rescued by some Alchemist and came back to life, but you should go to Lutie if you wanna know more about him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
不過沒關係，因為他被一位鍊金術士救了出來，重新獲得了生命，但如果你想了解更多關於他的事，應該去薑餅城看看，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
You're gonna leave right now and not even listen to me a little bit? Okay, I'm cool, but promise you'll come back and listen to just one of my songs, okay?
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
你現在就要走，連聽我唱一小段都不願意嗎？好吧，我無所謂，但答應我你會回來聽我唱一首歌，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gunther Doubleharmony]
Wow, you're ignoring me, huh? Alright, that's fine by me! Unless you have some kind of problem where you can't talk, then I'm really really sorry.
scripts.translation:
[岡瑟·雙和諧]
哇，你在無視我，是嗎？好吧，那也沒關係！除非你有某種無法說話的困擾，如果是那樣，我真的非常非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Welcome to the
Monster Research
Organization.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
歡迎來到魔物研究組織。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We are researching monsters based upon information from adventurers in order to efficiently cope with monsters out in the wild.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
我們根據冒險者提供的資訊研究魔物，以便更有效地應對野外出現的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We're accepting any kind of information related to monsters,
so if you have any news or info, please don't hesitate to submit it to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
我們接受任何與魔物相關的資訊，如果您有任何訊息或情報，請隨時提交給我。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
You can use the report documentation form in
this room at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
您可以隨時使用本房間內的報告記錄表。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Eh...?
Did you just say
you're looking for
someone? Well...
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
呃...？
您剛才說您在找什麼人嗎？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Well, if he's a registered
member of this organization,
I can help you.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
嗯，如果他是本組織的註冊會員，我可以幫您查一下。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
What was the name?
Hermite Charles...?
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
他叫什麼名字？
隱士 查爾斯...？

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Oh, I found him.
Errr, but he didn't submit all of the required information when he applied for membership...
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
哦，我找到了。
呃，但他申請會員時並沒有填寫所有必填資訊...

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Oh. He's a Rogue.
Well, that explains everything. Anyway, did you want to see all
the information we have?
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
哦，他是個流氓。
這就說得通了。
總之，您想看看我們掌握的所有資訊嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFMarlin shows you
the membership
application card.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF馬林向您展示了會員卡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Membership Card]
Name: Hermite Charles
Job: Rogue
Sex: Rogue
Address: Yo Mama Street, Prontera
scripts.translation:
[會員卡]
姓名：隱士·查爾斯
職業：流氓
性別：流氓
地址：普隆德拉你媽街

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Unfortunately, we don't have any more information. But I hope this will be helpful to you in some way.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
很遺憾，我們沒有更多其他資訊了。但我希望這能在某種程度上對您有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Still, it may be a good idea to visit the Rogue Guild. Perhaps
they can help you.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
不過，也許去流氓公會看看是個好主意。
也許他們能幫到您。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We are researching monsters based on information from adventurers in order to efficiently cope with monsters out in the wild.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
我們根據冒險者提供的資訊研究魔物，以便更有效地應對野外出現的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
We're accepting any kind of information related to monsters, so if you have any news or info, please don't hesitate to submit it to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
我們接受任何與魔物相關的資訊，如果您有任何訊息或情報，請隨時提交給我。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
You can use the report documentation form in this room at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
您可以隨時使用本房間內的報告記錄表。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Hmmm?
Adventurers of this organization? Ah, you say you're looking for a Bard?
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
嗯？
本組織的冒險者？
啊，您說您在找一位詩人？

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putuir]
Yes, we have a few Bard members who regularly send us information related to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
是的，我們有幾位詩人成員定期向我們提供與魔物相關的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
I also hear the Bards have been helping scholars instill bulletin boards in fields which indicate the location for new adventurers. Would you let me know the full name of the person you're looking for?
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
我還聽說詩人們一直在幫助學者在野外設定告示牌，以指示新冒險者的位置。請告訴我您要找的人的全名好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Minty Errende...
Oh yes, I remember him. He told me a while ago that he's heading South, and that he's staying in Geffen now.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
薄荷·艾倫德...哦，我想起來了。
他之前告訴我他要往南走，現在應該住在吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
He's a very kind, friendly person. Errende's always doing his best to provide us with the information we need. When you get a chance, would you please give him my regards?
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
他是個非常友善、親切的人。艾倫德總是盡力為我們提供所需的資訊。如果您有機會見到他，請代我向他問好。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Kino Kitty, Kino Kitty... Oh, here we are. He sent us a letter that says, 'I will stay in the desert until I find my real self.'
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
基諾·基蒂，基諾·基蒂... 哦，我們到了。他給我們寄了一封信，上面寫著：“我會留在沙漠，直到找到真正的自己。”

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
He doesn't seem healthy, but I guess he's still traveling. Trying seeking him out in Morocc, and give my regards to him if you get the chance.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
他看起來身體不太好，但我猜他還在旅途中。請嘗試在夢羅克尋找他，如果有機會見到他，請代我向他問好。

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Ah, are you a friend of Gunther's? Haha, he's a very funny guy, if a little excitable. Let's see, Gunther, Gunther...
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
啊，您是岡瑟的朋友嗎？哈哈，他是個很有趣的傢伙，雖然有點容易激動。讓我想想，岡瑟，岡瑟...

scripts.text:
[Marlin Putiur]
Ah, it says here that he wanted to look around Payon and Alberta. So he'll be at one of those places. I'm sorry I can't be more specific.
scripts.translation:
[馬林·普蒂爾]
